37::CODE;;def distance(pt1, pt2):
38::CODE;;return sqrt((pt1[0] - pt2[0]) ** 2. + (pt1[1] - pt2[1]) ** 2.)
39::CODE;;def polar_to_rect(origin, r, theta):
40::CODE;;return origin[0] + r * cos(theta), origin[1] + r * sin(theta)
41::CODE;;def rect_to_polar(origin, x, y):
42::CODE;;if x == origin[0]:
43::CODE;;if y == origin[1]:
44::CODE;;return 0, 0
45::CODE;;elif y > origin[1]:
46::CODE;;return y - origin[1], pi / 2
47::CODE;;else:
48::CODE;;return origin[1] - y, 3 * pi / 2
49::CODE;;t = atan(float((y - origin[1])) / (x - origin[0]))
50::CODE;;if x - origin[0] < 0:
51::CODE;;t += pi
52::CODE;;if t < 0:
53::CODE;;t += 2 * pi
54::CODE;;return distance((x, y), origin), t
55::CODE;;class ColorWheel(Widget):
56::CODE;;'''Chromatic wheel for the ColorPicker.
57::CODE;;.. versionchanged:: 1.7.1
58::CODE;;`font_size`, `font_name` and `foreground_color` have been removed. The
59::CODE;;sizing is now the same as others widget, based on 'sp'. Orientation is
60::CODE;;also automatically determined according to the width/height ratio.
61::CODE;;'''
62::CODE;;r = BoundedNumericProperty(0, min=0, max=1)
63::CODE;;'''The Red value of the color currently selected.
64::CODE;;:attr:`r` is a :class:`~kivy.properties.BoundedNumericProperty` and
65::CODE;;can be a value from 0 to 1. It defaults to 0.
66::CODE;;'''
67::CODE;;g = BoundedNumericProperty(0, min=0, max=1)
68::CODE;;'''The Green value of the color currently selected.
69::CODE;;:attr:`g` is a :class:`~kivy.properties.BoundedNumericProperty`
70::CODE;;and can be a value from 0 to 1. It defaults to 0.
71::CODE;;'''
72::CODE;;b = BoundedNumericProperty(0, min=0, max=1)
73::CODE;;'''The Blue value of the color currently selected.
74::CODE;;:attr:`b` is a :class:`~kivy.properties.BoundedNumericProperty` and
75::CODE;;can be a value from 0 to 1. It defaults to 0.
76::CODE;;'''
77::CODE;;a = BoundedNumericProperty(0, min=0, max=1)
78::CODE;;'''The Alpha value of the color currently selected.
79::CODE;;:attr:`a` is a :class:`~kivy.properties.BoundedNumericProperty` and
80::CODE;;can be a value from 0 to 1. It defaults to 0.
81::CODE;;'''
82::CODE;;color = ReferenceListProperty(r, g, b, a)
83::CODE;;'''The holds the color currently selected.
84::CODE;;:attr:`color` is a :class:`~kivy.properties.ReferenceListProperty` and
85::CODE;;contains a list of `r`, `g`, `b`, `a` values. It defaults to `[0, 0, 0, 0]`.
86::CODE;;'''
87::CODE;;_origin = ListProperty((100, 100))
88::CODE;;_radius = NumericProperty(100)
89::CODE;;_piece_divisions = NumericProperty(10)
90::CODE;;_pieces_of_pie = NumericProperty(16)
91::CODE;;_inertia_slowdown = 1.25
92::CODE;;_inertia_cutoff = .25
93::CODE;;_num_touches = 0
94::CODE;;_pinch_flag = False
95::CODE;;def __init__(self, **kwargs):
96::CODE;;self.arcs = []
97::CODE;;self.sv_idx = 0
98::CODE;;pdv = self._piece_divisions
99::CODE;;self.sv_s = [(float(x) / pdv, 1) for x in range(pdv)] + [
100::CODE;;(1, float(y) / pdv) for y in reversed(range(pdv))]
101::CODE;;super(ColorWheel, self).__init__(**kwargs)
102::CODE;;def on__origin(self, _instance, _value):
103::CODE;;self._reset_canvas()
104::CODE;;def on__radius(self, _instance, _value):
105::CODE;;self._reset_canvas()
106::CODE;;def _reset_canvas(self):
108::CODE;;self.canvas.clear()
109::CODE;;self.arcs = []
110::CODE;;self.sv_idx = 0
111::CODE;;pdv = self._piece_divisions
112::CODE;;ppie = self._pieces_of_pie
113::CODE;;for r in range(pdv):
114::CODE;;for t in range(ppie):
115::CODE;;self.arcs.append(
116::CODE;;_ColorArc(
117::CODE;;self._radius * (float(r) / float(pdv)),
118::CODE;;self._radius * (float(r + 1) / float(pdv)),
119::CODE;;2 * pi * (float(t) / float(ppie)),
120::CODE;;2 * pi * (float(t + 1) / float(ppie)),
121::CODE;;origin=self._origin,
122::CODE;;color=(float(t) / ppie,
123::CODE;;self.sv_s[self.sv_idx + r][0],
124::CODE;;self.sv_s[self.sv_idx + r][1],
125::CODE;;1)))
126::CODE;;self.canvas.add(self.arcs[-1])
127::CODE;;def recolor_wheel(self):
128::CODE;;ppie = self._pieces_of_pie
129::CODE;;for idx, segment in enumerate(self.arcs):
130::CODE;;segment.change_color(
131::CODE;;sv=self.sv_s[int(self.sv_idx + idx / ppie)])
132::CODE;;def change_alpha(self, val):
133::CODE;;for idx, segment in enumerate(self.arcs):
134::CODE;;segment.change_color(a=val)
135::CODE;;def inertial_incr_sv_idx(self, dt):
137::CODE;;if self.sv_idx == len(self.sv_s) - self._piece_divisions:
138::CODE;;return False
139::CODE;;self.sv_idx += 1
140::CODE;;self.recolor_wheel()
141::CODE;;if dt * self._inertia_slowdown > self._inertia_cutoff:
142::CODE;;return False
143::CODE;;else:
144::CODE;;Clock.schedule_once(self.inertial_incr_sv_idx,
145::CODE;;dt * self._inertia_slowdown)
146::CODE;;def inertial_decr_sv_idx(self, dt):
148::CODE;;if self.sv_idx == 0:
149::CODE;;return False
150::CODE;;self.sv_idx -= 1
151::CODE;;self.recolor_wheel()
152::CODE;;if dt * self._inertia_slowdown > self._inertia_cutoff:
153::CODE;;return False
154::CODE;;else:
155::CODE;;Clock.schedule_once(self.inertial_decr_sv_idx,
156::CODE;;dt * self._inertia_slowdown)
157::CODE;;def on_touch_down(self, touch):
158::CODE;;r = self._get_touch_r(touch.pos)
159::CODE;;if r > self._radius:
160::CODE;;return False
165::CODE;;if self._num_touches != 0:
166::CODE;;return False
167::CODE;;touch.grab(self)
168::CODE;;self._num_touches += 1
169::CODE;;touch.ud['anchor_r'] = r
170::CODE;;touch.ud['orig_sv_idx'] = self.sv_idx
171::CODE;;touch.ud['orig_time'] = Clock.get_time()
172::CODE;;def on_touch_move(self, touch):
173::CODE;;if touch.grab_current is not self:
174::CODE;;return
175::CODE;;r = self._get_touch_r(touch.pos)
176::CODE;;goal_sv_idx = (touch.ud['orig_sv_idx'] -
177::CODE;;int((r - touch.ud['anchor_r']) /
178::CODE;;(float(self._radius) / self._piece_divisions)))
179::CODE;;if (
180::CODE;;goal_sv_idx != self.sv_idx and
181::CODE;;0 <= goal_sv_idx <= len(self.sv_s) - self._piece_divisions
182::CODE;;):
184::CODE;;self._pinch_flag = True
185::CODE;;self.sv_idx = goal_sv_idx
186::CODE;;self.recolor_wheel()
187::CODE;;def on_touch_up(self, touch):
188::CODE;;if touch.grab_current is not self:
189::CODE;;return
190::CODE;;touch.ungrab(self)
191::CODE;;self._num_touches -= 1
192::CODE;;if self._pinch_flag:
193::CODE;;if self._num_touches == 0:
196::CODE;;if self.sv_idx > touch.ud['orig_sv_idx']:
197::CODE;;Clock.schedule_once(
198::CODE;;self.inertial_incr_sv_idx,
199::CODE;;(Clock.get_time() - touch.ud['orig_time']) /
200::CODE;;(self.sv_idx - touch.ud['orig_sv_idx']))
201::CODE;;if self.sv_idx < touch.ud['orig_sv_idx']:
202::CODE;;Clock.schedule_once(
203::CODE;;self.inertial_decr_sv_idx,
204::CODE;;(Clock.get_time() - touch.ud['orig_time']) /
205::CODE;;(self.sv_idx - touch.ud['orig_sv_idx']))
206::CODE;;self._pinch_flag = False
207::CODE;;return
208::CODE;;else:
211::CODE;;return
212::CODE;;else:
213::CODE;;r, theta = rect_to_polar(self._origin, *touch.pos)
215::CODE;;if r >= self._radius:
216::CODE;;return
220::CODE;;piece = int((theta / (2 * pi)) * self._pieces_of_pie)
221::CODE;;division = int((r / self._radius) * self._piece_divisions)
222::CODE;;hsva = list(
223::CODE;;self.arcs[self._pieces_of_pie * division + piece].color)
224::CODE;;self.color = list(hsv_to_rgb(*hsva[:3])) + hsva[-1:]
225::CODE;;def _get_touch_r(self, pos):
226::CODE;;return distance(pos, self._origin)
227::CODE;;class _ColorArc(InstructionGroup):
228::CODE;;def __init__(self, r_min, r_max, theta_min, theta_max,
229::CODE;;color=(0, 0, 1, 1), origin=(0, 0), **kwargs):
230::CODE;;super(_ColorArc, self).__init__(**kwargs)
231::CODE;;self.origin = origin
232::CODE;;self.r_min = r_min
233::CODE;;self.r_max = r_max
234::CODE;;self.theta_min = theta_min
235::CODE;;self.theta_max = theta_max
236::CODE;;self.color = color
237::CODE;;self.color_instr = Color(*color, mode='hsv')
238::CODE;;self.add(self.color_instr)
239::CODE;;self.mesh = self.get_mesh()
240::CODE;;self.add(self.mesh)
241::CODE;;def __str__(self):
242::CODE;;return "r_min: %s r_max: %s theta_min: %s theta_max: %s color: %s" % (
243::CODE;;self.r_min, self.r_max, self.theta_min, self.theta_max, self.color
244::CODE;;)
245::CODE;;def get_mesh(self):
246::CODE;;v = []
250::CODE;;theta_step_outer = 0.1
251::CODE;;theta = self.theta_max - self.theta_min
252::CODE;;d_outer = int(theta / theta_step_outer)
253::CODE;;theta_step_outer = theta / d_outer
254::CODE;;if self.r_min == 0:
255::CODE;;for x in range(0, d_outer, 2):
256::CODE;;v += (polar_to_rect(self.origin, self.r_max,
257::CODE;;self.theta_min + x * theta_step_outer
258::CODE;;) * 2)
259::CODE;;v += polar_to_rect(self.origin, 0, 0) * 2
260::CODE;;v += (polar_to_rect(self.origin, self.r_max,
261::CODE;;self.theta_min + (x + 1) * theta_step_outer
262::CODE;;) * 2)
264::CODE;;v += (polar_to_rect(self.origin, self.r_max,
265::CODE;;self.theta_min + d_outer * theta_step_outer
266::CODE;;) * 2)
267::CODE;;else:
268::CODE;;for x in range(d_outer + 1):
269::CODE;;v += (polar_to_rect(self.origin, self.r_min,
270::CODE;;self.theta_min + x * theta_step_outer
271::CODE;;) * 2)
272::CODE;;v += (polar_to_rect(self.origin, self.r_max,
273::CODE;;self.theta_min + x * theta_step_outer
274::CODE;;) * 2)
275::CODE;;return Mesh(vertices=v, indices=range(int(len(v) / 4)),
276::CODE;;mode='triangle_strip')
277::CODE;;def change_color(self, color=None, color_delta=None, sv=None, a=None):
278::CODE;;self.remove(self.color_instr)
279::CODE;;if color is not None:
280::CODE;;self.color = color
281::CODE;;elif color_delta is not None:
282::CODE;;self.color = [self.color[i] + color_delta[i] for i in range(4)]
283::CODE;;elif sv is not None:
284::CODE;;self.color = (self.color[0], sv[0], sv[1], self.color[3])
285::CODE;;elif a is not None:
286::CODE;;self.color = (self.color[0], self.color[1], self.color[2], a)
287::CODE;;self.color_instr = Color(*self.color, mode='hsv')
288::CODE;;self.insert(0, self.color_instr)

1::CODE;;'''
2::CODE;;Drop-Down List
3::CODE;;==============
4::CODE;;.. image:: images/dropdown.gif
5::CODE;;:align: right
6::CODE;;.. versionadded:: 1.4.0
7::CODE;;A versatile drop-down list that can be used with custom widgets. It allows you
8::CODE;;to display a list of widgets under a displayed widget. Unlike other toolkits,
9::CODE;;the list of widgets can contain any type of widget: simple buttons,
10::CODE;;images etc.
11::CODE;;The positioning of the drop-down list is fully automatic: we will always try to
12::CODE;;place the dropdown list in a way that the user can select an item in the list.
13::CODE;;Basic example
14::CODE;;-------------
15::CODE;;A button with a dropdown list of 10 possible values. All the buttons within the
16::CODE;;dropdown list will trigger the dropdown :meth:`DropDown.select` method. After
17::CODE;;being called, the main button text will display the selection of the
18::CODE;;dropdown. ::
19::CODE;;from kivy.uix.dropdown import DropDown
20::CODE;;from kivy.uix.button import Button
21::CODE;;from kivy.base import runTouchApp
23::CODE;;dropdown = DropDown()
24::CODE;;for index in range(10):
28::CODE;;btn = Button(text='Value %d' % index, size_hint_y=None, height=44)
32::CODE;;btn.bind(on_release=lambda btn: dropdown.select(btn.text))
34::CODE;;dropdown.add_widget(btn)
36::CODE;;mainbutton = Button(text='Hello', size_hint=(None, None))
41::CODE;;mainbutton.bind(on_release=dropdown.open)
44::CODE;;dropdown.bind(on_select=lambda instance, x: setattr(mainbutton, 'text', x))
45::CODE;;runTouchApp(mainbutton)
46::CODE;;Extending dropdown in Kv
47::CODE;;------------------------
48::CODE;;You could create a dropdown directly from your kv::
50::CODE;;<CustomDropDown>:
51::CODE;;Button:
52::CODE;;text: 'My first Item'
53::CODE;;size_hint_y: None
54::CODE;;height: 44
55::CODE;;on_release: root.select('item1')
56::CODE;;Label:
57::CODE;;text: 'Unselectable item'
58::CODE;;size_hint_y: None
59::CODE;;height: 44
60::CODE;;Button:
61::CODE;;text: 'My second Item'
62::CODE;;size_hint_y: None
63::CODE;;height: 44
64::CODE;;on_release: root.select('item2')
65::CODE;;And then, create the associated python class and use it::
66::CODE;;class CustomDropDown(DropDown):
67::CODE;;pass
68::CODE;;dropdown = CustomDropDown()
69::CODE;;mainbutton = Button(text='Hello', size_hint=(None, None))
70::CODE;;mainbutton.bind(on_release=dropdown.open)
71::CODE;;dropdown.bind(on_select=lambda instance, x: setattr(mainbutton, 'text', x))
72::CODE;;'''
73::CODE;;__all__ = ('DropDown', )
74::CODE;;from kivy.uix.scrollview import ScrollView
75::CODE;;from kivy.properties import ObjectProperty, NumericProperty, BooleanProperty
76::CODE;;from kivy.core.window import Window
77::CODE;;from kivy.lang import Builder
78::CODE;;from kivy.clock import Clock
79::CODE;;from kivy.config import Config
80::CODE;;_grid_kv = '''
81::CODE;;GridLayout:
82::CODE;;size_hint_y: None
83::CODE;;height: self.minimum_size[1]
84::CODE;;cols: 1
85::CODE;;'''
86::CODE;;class DropDownException(Exception):
87::CODE;;'''DropDownException class.
88::CODE;;'''
89::CODE;;pass
90::CODE;;class DropDown(ScrollView):
91::CODE;;'''DropDown class. See module documentation for more information.
92::CODE;;:Events:
93::CODE;;`on_select`: data
94::CODE;;Fired when a selection is done. The data of the selection is passed
95::CODE;;in as the first argument and is what you pass in the :meth:`select`
96::CODE;;method as the first argument.
97::CODE;;`on_dismiss`:
98::CODE;;.. versionadded:: 1.8.0
99::CODE;;Fired when the DropDown is dismissed, either on selection or on
100::CODE;;touching outside the widget.
101::CODE;;'''
102::CODE;;auto_width = BooleanProperty(True)
103::CODE;;'''By default, the width of the dropdown will be the same as the width of
104::CODE;;the attached widget. Set to False if you want to provide your own width.
105::CODE;;:attr:`auto_width` is a :class:`~kivy.properties.BooleanProperty`
106::CODE;;and defaults to True.
107::CODE;;'''
108::CODE;;max_height = NumericProperty(None, allownone=True)
109::CODE;;'''Indicate the maximum height that the dropdown can take. If None, it will

1::CODE;;'''
2::CODE;;EffectWidget
3::CODE;;============
4::CODE;;.. versionadded:: 1.9.0
5::CODE;;The :class:`EffectWidget` is able to apply a variety of fancy
6::CODE;;graphical effects to
7::CODE;;its children. It works by rendering to a series of
8::CODE;;:class:`~kivy.graphics.Fbo` instances with custom opengl fragment shaders.
9::CODE;;As such, effects can freely do almost anything, from inverting the
10::CODE;;colors of the widget, to anti-aliasing, to emulating the appearance of a
11::CODE;;crt monitor!
12::CODE;;.. warning::
13::CODE;;This code is still experimental, and its API is subject to change in a
14::CODE;;future version.
15::CODE;;The basic usage is as follows::
16::CODE;;w = EffectWidget()
17::CODE;;w.add_widget(Button(text='Hello!')
18::CODE;;w.effects = [InvertEffect(), HorizontalBlurEffect(size=2.0)]
19::CODE;;The equivalent in kv would be::
21::CODE;;EffectWidget:
22::CODE;;effects: ew.InvertEffect(), ew.HorizontalBlurEffect(size=2.0)
23::CODE;;Button:
24::CODE;;text: 'Hello!'
25::CODE;;The effects can be a list of effects of any length, and they will be
26::CODE;;applied sequentially.
27::CODE;;The module comes with a range of prebuilt effects, but the interface
28::CODE;;is designed to make it easy to create your own. Instead of writing a
29::CODE;;full glsl shader, you provide a single function that takes
30::CODE;;some inputs based on the screen (current pixel color, current widget
31::CODE;;texture etc.). See the sections below for more information.
32::CODE;;Usage Guidelines
33::CODE;;----------------
34::CODE;;It is not efficient to resize an :class:`EffectWidget`, as
35::CODE;;the :class:`~kivy.graphics.Fbo` is recreated on each resize event.
36::CODE;;If you need to resize frequently, consider doing things a different
37::CODE;;way.
38::CODE;;Although some effects have adjustable parameters, it is
39::CODE;;*not* efficient to animate these, as the entire
40::CODE;;shader is reconstructed every time. You should use glsl
41::CODE;;uniform variables instead. The :class:`AdvancedEffectBase`
42::CODE;;may make this easier.
43::CODE;;.. note:: The :class:`EffectWidget` *cannot* draw outside its own
44::CODE;;widget area (pos -> pos + size). Any child widgets
45::CODE;;overlapping the boundary will be cut off at this point.
46::CODE;;Provided Effects
47::CODE;;----------------
48::CODE;;The module comes with several pre-written effects. Some have
49::CODE;;adjustable properties (e.g. blur radius). Please see the individual
50::CODE;;effect documentation for more details.
51::CODE;;- :class:`MonochromeEffect` - makes the widget grayscale.
52::CODE;;- :class:`InvertEffect` - inverts the widget colors.
53::CODE;;- :class:`ChannelMixEffect` - swaps color channels.
54::CODE;;- :class:`ScanlinesEffect` - displays flickering scanlines.
55::CODE;;- :class:`PixelateEffect` - pixelates the image.
56::CODE;;- :class:`HorizontalBlurEffect` - Gaussuan blurs horizontally.
57::CODE;;- :class:`VerticalBlurEffect` - Gaussuan blurs vertically.
58::CODE;;- :class:`FXAAEffect` - applies a very basic anti-aliasing.
59::CODE;;Creating Effects
60::CODE;;----------------
61::CODE;;Effects are designed to make it easy to create and use your own
62::CODE;;transformations. You do this by creating and using an instance of
63::CODE;;:class:`EffectBase` with your own custom :attr:`EffectBase.glsl`
64::CODE;;property.
65::CODE;;The glsl property is a string representing part of a glsl fragment
66::CODE;;shader. You can include as many functions as you like (the string
67::CODE;;is simply spliced into the whole shader), but it
68::CODE;;must implement a function :code:`effect` as below::
69::CODE;;vec4 effect(vec4 color, sampler2D texture, vec2 tex_coords, vec2 coords)
70::CODE;;{
71::CODE;;// ... your code here
72::CODE;;return something; // must be a vec4 representing the new color
73::CODE;;}
74::CODE;;The full shader will calculate the normal pixel color at each point,
75::CODE;;then call your :code:`effect` function to transform it. The
76::CODE;;parameters are:
77::CODE;;- **color**: The normal color of the current pixel (i.e. texture
78::CODE;;sampled at tex_coords).
79::CODE;;- **texture**: The texture containing the widget's normal background.
80::CODE;;- **tex_coords**: The normal texture_coords used to access texture.
81::CODE;;- **coords**: The pixel indices of the current pixel.
82::CODE;;The shader code also has access to two useful uniform variables,
83::CODE;;:code:`time` containing the time (in seconds) since the program start,
84::CODE;;and :code:`resolution` containing the shape (x pixels, y pixels) of
85::CODE;;the widget.
86::CODE;;For instance, the following simple string (taken from the `InvertEffect`)
87::CODE;;would invert the input color but set alpha to 1.0::
88::CODE;;vec4 effect(vec4 color, sampler2D texture, vec2 tex_coords, vec2 coords)
89::CODE;;{
90::CODE;;return vec4(1.0 - color.xyz, 1.0);
91::CODE;;}
92::CODE;;You can also set the glsl by automatically loading the string from a
93::CODE;;file, simply set the :attr:`EffectBase.source` property of an effect.
94::CODE;;'''
95::CODE;;from kivy.clock import Clock
96::CODE;;from kivy.uix.relativelayout import RelativeLayout
97::CODE;;from kivy.properties import (StringProperty, ObjectProperty, ListProperty,
98::CODE;;NumericProperty, DictProperty)
99::CODE;;from kivy.graphics import (RenderContext, Fbo, Color, Rectangle,
100::CODE;;Translate, PushMatrix, PopMatrix, ClearColor,
101::CODE;;ClearBuffers)
102::CODE;;from kivy.event import EventDispatcher

244::CODE;;effect_fxaa = '''
245::CODE;;vec4 effect( vec4 color, sampler2D buf0, vec2 texCoords, vec2 coords)
246::CODE;;{
247::CODE;;vec2 frameBufSize = resolution;
248::CODE;;float FXAA_SPAN_MAX = 8.0;
249::CODE;;float FXAA_REDUCE_MUL = 1.0/8.0;
250::CODE;;float FXAA_REDUCE_MIN = 1.0/128.0;
251::CODE;;vec3 rgbNW=texture2D(buf0,texCoords+(vec2(-1.0,-1.0)/frameBufSize)).xyz;
252::CODE;;vec3 rgbNE=texture2D(buf0,texCoords+(vec2(1.0,-1.0)/frameBufSize)).xyz;
253::CODE;;vec3 rgbSW=texture2D(buf0,texCoords+(vec2(-1.0,1.0)/frameBufSize)).xyz;
254::CODE;;vec3 rgbSE=texture2D(buf0,texCoords+(vec2(1.0,1.0)/frameBufSize)).xyz;
255::CODE;;vec3 rgbM=texture2D(buf0,texCoords).xyz;
256::CODE;;vec3 luma=vec3(0.299, 0.587, 0.114);
257::CODE;;float lumaNW = dot(rgbNW, luma);
258::CODE;;float lumaNE = dot(rgbNE, luma);
259::CODE;;float lumaSW = dot(rgbSW, luma);
260::CODE;;float lumaSE = dot(rgbSE, luma);
261::CODE;;float lumaM = dot(rgbM, luma);
262::CODE;;float lumaMin = min(lumaM, min(min(lumaNW, lumaNE), min(lumaSW, lumaSE)));
263::CODE;;float lumaMax = max(lumaM, max(max(lumaNW, lumaNE), max(lumaSW, lumaSE)));
264::CODE;;vec2 dir;
265::CODE;;dir.x = -((lumaNW + lumaNE) - (lumaSW + lumaSE));
266::CODE;;dir.y = ((lumaNW + lumaSW) - (lumaNE + lumaSE));
267::CODE;;float dirReduce = max(
268::CODE;;(lumaNW + lumaNE + lumaSW + lumaSE) * (0.25 * FXAA_REDUCE_MUL),
269::CODE;;FXAA_REDUCE_MIN);
270::CODE;;float rcpDirMin = 1.0/(min(abs(dir.x), abs(dir.y)) + dirReduce);
271::CODE;;dir = min(vec2(FXAA_SPAN_MAX, FXAA_SPAN_MAX),
272::CODE;;max(vec2(-FXAA_SPAN_MAX, -FXAA_SPAN_MAX),
273::CODE;;dir * rcpDirMin)) / frameBufSize;
274::CODE;;vec3 rgbA = (1.0/2.0) * (
275::CODE;;texture2D(buf0, texCoords.xy + dir * (1.0/3.0 - 0.5)).xyz +
276::CODE;;texture2D(buf0, texCoords.xy + dir * (2.0/3.0 - 0.5)).xyz);
277::CODE;;vec3 rgbB = rgbA * (1.0/2.0) + (1.0/4.0) * (
278::CODE;;texture2D(buf0, texCoords.xy + dir * (0.0/3.0 - 0.5)).xyz +
279::CODE;;texture2D(buf0, texCoords.xy + dir * (3.0/3.0 - 0.5)).xyz);
280::CODE;;float lumaB = dot(rgbB, luma);
281::CODE;;vec4 return_color;
282::CODE;;if((lumaB < lumaMin) || (lumaB > lumaMax)){
283::CODE;;return_color = vec4(rgbA, color.w);
284::CODE;;}else{
285::CODE;;return_color = vec4(rgbB, color.w);
286::CODE;;}
287::CODE;;return return_color;
288::CODE;;}
289::CODE;;'''

533::CODE;;self._background_color.rgba = self.background_color

540::CODE;;self.canvas['time'] = time
541::CODE;;self.canvas['resolution'] = resolution
542::CODE;;for fbo in self.fbo_list:
543::CODE;;fbo['time'] = time

545::CODE;;def refresh_fbo_setup(self, *args):
546::CODE;;'''(internal) Creates and assigns one :class:`~kivy.graphics.Fbo`
547::CODE;;per effect, and makes sure all sizes etc. are correct and
548::CODE;;consistent.
549::CODE;;'''
551::CODE;;while len(self.fbo_list) < len(self.effects):
552::CODE;;with self.canvas:

559::CODE;;new_fbo.texture_rectangle.size = self.size
560::CODE;;self.fbo_list.append(new_fbo)
561::CODE;;while len(self.fbo_list) > len(self.effects):
562::CODE;;old_fbo = self.fbo_list.pop()
563::CODE;;self.canvas.remove(old_fbo)
565::CODE;;for effect in self._bound_effects:

567::CODE;;effect.fbo = None

576::CODE;;if len(self.fbo_list) == 0:

583::CODE;;for effect, fbo in zip(self.effects, self.fbo_list):
584::CODE;;effect.fbo = fbo

586::CODE;;self.texture = self.fbo_list[-1].texture

1::CODE;;'''
2::CODE;;FileChooser
3::CODE;;===========
4::CODE;;The FileChooser module provides various classes for describing, displaying and
5::CODE;;browsing file systems.
6::CODE;;Simple widgets
7::CODE;;--------------
8::CODE;;There are two ready-to-use widgets that provide views of the file system. Each
9::CODE;;of these present the files and folders in a different style.
10::CODE;;The :class:`FileChooserListView` displays file entries as text items in a
11::CODE;;vertical list, where folders can be collapsed and expanded.
12::CODE;;.. image:: images/filechooser_list.png
13::CODE;;The :class:`FileChooserIconView` presents icons and text from left to right,
14::CODE;;wrapping them as required.
15::CODE;;.. image:: images/filechooser_icon.png
16::CODE;;They both provide for scrolling, selection and basic user interaction.
17::CODE;;Please refer to the :class:`FileChooserController` for details on supported
18::CODE;;events and properties.
19::CODE;;Widget composition
20::CODE;;------------------
21::CODE;;FileChooser classes adopt a
22::CODE;;`MVC <https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Model%E2%80%93view%E2%80%93controller>`_
23::CODE;;design. They are exposed so that you to extend and customize your file chooser
24::CODE;;according to your needs.
25::CODE;;The FileChooser classes can be categorized as follows:
26::CODE;;* Models are represented by concrete implementations of the
27::CODE;;:class:`FileSystemAbstract` class, such as the :class:`FileSystemLocal`.
28::CODE;;* Views are represented by the :class:`FileChooserListLayout` and
29::CODE;;:class:`FileChooserIconLayout` classes. These are used by the
30::CODE;;:class:`FileChooserListView` and :class:`FileChooserIconView` widgets
31::CODE;;respectively.
32::CODE;;* Controllers are represented by concrete implementations of the
33::CODE;;:class:`FileChooserController`, namely the :class:`FileChooser`,
34::CODE;;:class:`FileChooserIconView` and :class:`FileChooserListView` classes.
35::CODE;;This means you can define your own views or provide :class:`FileSystemAbstract`
36::CODE;;implementations for alternative file systems for use with these widgets.
37::CODE;;The :class:`FileChooser` can be used as a controller for handling multiple,
38::CODE;;synchronized views of the same path. By combining these elements, you can add
39::CODE;;your own views and file systems and have them easily interact with the existing
40::CODE;;components.
41::CODE;;Usage example
42::CODE;;-------------
43::CODE;;main.py
44::CODE;;.. include:: ../../examples/RST_Editor/main.py
45::CODE;;:literal:
46::CODE;;editor.kv
47::CODE;;.. highlight:: kv
48::CODE;;.. include:: ../../examples/RST_Editor/editor.kv
49::CODE;;:literal:
50::CODE;;.. versionadded:: 1.0.5
51::CODE;;.. versionchanged:: 1.2.0
52::CODE;;In the chooser template, the `controller` is no longer a direct reference
53::CODE;;but a weak-reference. If you are upgrading, you should change the notation
54::CODE;;`root.controller.xxx` to `root.controller().xxx`.
55::CODE;;'''
56::CODE;;__all__ = ('FileChooserListView', 'FileChooserIconView',
57::CODE;;'FileChooserListLayout', 'FileChooserIconLayout',
58::CODE;;'FileChooser', 'FileChooserController',
59::CODE;;'FileChooserProgressBase', 'FileSystemAbstract',
60::CODE;;'FileSystemLocal')

221::CODE;;class FileChooserController(RelativeLayout):
222::CODE;;'''Base for implementing a FileChooser. Don't use this class directly, but
223::CODE;;prefer using an implementation such as the :class:`FileChooser`,
224::CODE;;:class:`FileChooserListView` or :class:`FileChooserIconView`.
225::CODE;;:Events:
226::CODE;;`on_entry_added`: entry, parent
227::CODE;;Fired when a root-level entry is added to the file list. If you
228::CODE;;return True from this event, the entry is not added to FileChooser.
229::CODE;;`on_entries_cleared`
230::CODE;;Fired when the entries list is cleared, usually when the
231::CODE;;root is refreshed.
232::CODE;;`on_subentry_to_entry`: entry, parent
233::CODE;;Fired when a sub-entry is added to an existing entry or
234::CODE;;when entries are removed from an entry e.g. when
235::CODE;;a node is closed.
236::CODE;;`on_submit`: selection, touch
237::CODE;;Fired when a file has been selected with a double-tap.
238::CODE;;'''
239::CODE;;_ENTRY_TEMPLATE = None
240::CODE;;layout = ObjectProperty(baseclass=FileChooserLayout)
241::CODE;;'''

243::CODE;;layout is an :class:`~kivy.properties.ObjectProperty`.
244::CODE;;.. versionadded:: 1.9.0
245::CODE;;'''
246::CODE;;path = StringProperty(u'/')
247::CODE;;'''
248::CODE;;path is a :class:`~kivy.properties.StringProperty` and defaults to the
249::CODE;;current working directory as a unicode string. It specifies the path on the
250::CODE;;filesystem that this controller should refer to.
251::CODE;;.. warning::
252::CODE;;If a unicode path is specified, all the files returned will be in
253::CODE;;unicode, allowing the display of unicode files and paths. If a bytes
254::CODE;;path is specified, only files and paths with ascii names will be
255::CODE;;displayed properly: non-ascii filenames will be displayed and listed
256::CODE;;with questions marks (?) instead of their unicode characters.
257::CODE;;'''
258::CODE;;filters = ListProperty([])
259::CODE;;'''
260::CODE;;filters specifies the filters to be applied to the files in the directory.
261::CODE;;filters is a :class:`~kivy.properties.ListProperty` and defaults to [].
262::CODE;;This is equivalent to '\\*' i.e. nothing is filtered.
263::CODE;;The filters are not reset when the path changes. You need to do that
264::CODE;;yourself if desired.
265::CODE;;There are two kinds of filters: patterns and callbacks.
267::CODE;;e.g. ['\\*.png'].
268::CODE;;You can use the following patterns:
269::CODE;;========== =================================
270::CODE;;Pattern Meaning
271::CODE;;========== =================================
272::CODE;;\\* matches everything
273::CODE;;? matches any single character
274::CODE;;[seq] matches any character in seq
275::CODE;;[!seq] matches any character not in seq
276::CODE;;========== =================================
278::CODE;;You can specify a function that will be called for each file. The
279::CODE;;callback will be passed the folder and file name as the first
280::CODE;;and second parameters respectively. It should return True to
281::CODE;;indicate a match and False otherwise.
282::CODE;;.. versionchanged:: 1.4.0
283::CODE;;Added the option to specify the filter as a callback.
284::CODE;;'''

1::CODE;;'''
2::CODE;;Float Layout
3::CODE;;============
4::CODE;;:class:`FloatLayout` honors the :attr:`~kivy.uix.widget.Widget.pos_hint`
5::CODE;;and the :attr:`~kivy.uix.widget.Widget.size_hint` properties of its children.
6::CODE;;.. only:: html
7::CODE;;.. image:: images/floatlayout.gif
8::CODE;;:align: right
9::CODE;;.. only:: latex
10::CODE;;.. image:: images/floatlayout.png
11::CODE;;:align: right
12::CODE;;For example, a FloatLayout with a size of (300, 300) is created::
13::CODE;;layout = FloatLayout(size=(300, 300))
14::CODE;;By default, all widgets have their size_hint=(1, 1), so this button will adopt
15::CODE;;the same size as the layout::
16::CODE;;button = Button(text='Hello world')
17::CODE;;layout.add_widget(button)
18::CODE;;To create a button 50% of the width and 25% of the height of the layout and
19::CODE;;positioned at (20, 20), you can do::
20::CODE;;button = Button(
21::CODE;;text='Hello world',
22::CODE;;size_hint=(.5, .25),
23::CODE;;pos=(20, 20))
24::CODE;;If you want to create a button that will always be the size of layout minus
25::CODE;;20% on each side::
26::CODE;;button = Button(text='Hello world', size_hint=(.6, .6),
27::CODE;;pos_hint={'x':.2, 'y':.2})
28::CODE;;.. note::
29::CODE;;This layout can be used for an application. Most of the time, you will
30::CODE;;use the size of Window.
31::CODE;;.. warning::
32::CODE;;If you are not using pos_hint, you must handle the positioning of the
33::CODE;;children: if the float layout is moving, you must handle moving the
34::CODE;;children too.
35::CODE;;'''
36::CODE;;__all__ = ('FloatLayout', )
37::CODE;;from kivy.uix.layout import Layout
38::CODE;;class FloatLayout(Layout):
39::CODE;;'''Float layout class. See module documentation for more information.
40::CODE;;'''
41::CODE;;def __init__(self, **kwargs):
42::CODE;;super(FloatLayout, self).__init__(**kwargs)
43::CODE;;fbind = self.fbind
44::CODE;;update = self._trigger_layout
45::CODE;;fbind('children', update)
46::CODE;;fbind('pos', update)
47::CODE;;fbind('pos_hint', update)
48::CODE;;fbind('size_hint', update)
49::CODE;;fbind('size', update)
50::CODE;;def do_layout(self, *largs, **kwargs):
52::CODE;;w, h = kwargs.get('size', self.size)
53::CODE;;x, y = kwargs.get('pos', self.pos)
54::CODE;;for c in self.children:
56::CODE;;shw, shh = c.size_hint
57::CODE;;shw_min, shh_min = c.size_hint_min
58::CODE;;shw_max, shh_max = c.size_hint_max
59::CODE;;if shw is not None and shh is not None:
60::CODE;;c_w = shw * w
61::CODE;;c_h = shh * h
62::CODE;;if shw_min is not None and c_w < shw_min:
63::CODE;;c_w = shw_min
64::CODE;;elif shw_max is not None and c_w > shw_max:
65::CODE;;c_w = shw_max
66::CODE;;if shh_min is not None and c_h < shh_min:
67::CODE;;c_h = shh_min
68::CODE;;elif shh_max is not None and c_h > shh_max:
69::CODE;;c_h = shh_max
70::CODE;;c.size = c_w, c_h
71::CODE;;elif shw is not None:
72::CODE;;c_w = shw * w
73::CODE;;if shw_min is not None and c_w < shw_min:
74::CODE;;c_w = shw_min
75::CODE;;elif shw_max is not None and c_w > shw_max:
76::CODE;;c_w = shw_max
77::CODE;;c.width = c_w
78::CODE;;elif shh is not None:
79::CODE;;c_h = shh * h
80::CODE;;if shh_min is not None and c_h < shh_min:
81::CODE;;c_h = shh_min
82::CODE;;elif shh_max is not None and c_h > shh_max:
83::CODE;;c_h = shh_max
84::CODE;;c.height = c_h
86::CODE;;for key, value in c.pos_hint.items():
87::CODE;;if key == 'x':
88::CODE;;c.x = x + value * w
89::CODE;;elif key == 'right':
90::CODE;;c.right = x + value * w
91::CODE;;elif key == 'pos':
92::CODE;;c.pos = x + value[0] * w, y + value[1] * h
93::CODE;;elif key == 'y':
94::CODE;;c.y = y + value * h
95::CODE;;elif key == 'top':
96::CODE;;c.top = y + value * h
97::CODE;;elif key == 'center':
98::CODE;;c.center = x + value[0] * w, y + value[1] * h
99::CODE;;elif key == 'center_x':
100::CODE;;c.center_x = x + value * w
101::CODE;;elif key == 'center_y':
102::CODE;;c.center_y = y + value * h
103::CODE;;def add_widget(self, widget, *args, **kwargs):
104::CODE;;widget.bind(
107::CODE;;pos=self._trigger_layout,
108::CODE;;pos_hint=self._trigger_layout)
109::CODE;;return super(FloatLayout, self).add_widget(widget, *args, **kwargs)
110::CODE;;def remove_widget(self, widget, *args, **kwargs):
111::CODE;;widget.unbind(
114::CODE;;pos=self._trigger_layout,
115::CODE;;pos_hint=self._trigger_layout)
116::CODE;;return super(FloatLayout, self).remove_widget(widget, *args, **kwargs)
1::CODE;;'''
2::CODE;;Gesture Surface
3::CODE;;===============
4::CODE;;.. versionadded::
5::CODE;;1.9.0
6::CODE;;.. warning::
7::CODE;;This is experimental and subject to change as long as this warning notice
8::CODE;;is present.
9::CODE;;See :file:`kivy/examples/demo/multistroke/main.py` for a complete application
10::CODE;;example.
11::CODE;;'''
12::CODE;;__all__ = ('GestureSurface', 'GestureContainer')
13::CODE;;from random import random
14::CODE;;from kivy.event import EventDispatcher
15::CODE;;from kivy.clock import Clock
16::CODE;;from kivy.vector import Vector
17::CODE;;from kivy.uix.floatlayout import FloatLayout
18::CODE;;from kivy.graphics import Color, Line, Rectangle
19::CODE;;from kivy.properties import (NumericProperty, BooleanProperty,
20::CODE;;DictProperty, ColorProperty)
21::CODE;;from colorsys import hsv_to_rgb
23::CODE;;UNDERSHOOT_MARGIN = 0.1
24::CODE;;class GestureContainer(EventDispatcher):
25::CODE;;'''Container object that stores information about a gesture. It has
26::CODE;;various properties that are updated by `GestureSurface` as drawing
27::CODE;;progresses.
28::CODE;;:Arguments:
29::CODE;;`touch`
30::CODE;;Touch object (as received by on_touch_down) used to initialize
31::CODE;;the gesture container. Required.
32::CODE;;:Properties:
33::CODE;;`active`
34::CODE;;Set to False once the gesture is complete (meets
35::CODE;;`max_stroke` setting or `GestureSurface.temporal_window`)
36::CODE;;:attr:`active` is a
37::CODE;;:class:`~kivy.properties.BooleanProperty`
38::CODE;;`active_strokes`
39::CODE;;Number of strokes currently active in the gesture, ie
40::CODE;;concurrent touches associated with this gesture.
41::CODE;;:attr:`active_strokes` is a
42::CODE;;:class:`~kivy.properties.NumericProperty`
43::CODE;;`max_strokes`
44::CODE;;Max number of strokes allowed in the gesture. This
45::CODE;;is set by `GestureSurface.max_strokes` but can
46::CODE;;be overridden for example from `on_gesture_start`.
47::CODE;;:attr:`max_strokes` is a
48::CODE;;:class:`~kivy.properties.NumericProperty`
49::CODE;;`was_merged`
50::CODE;;Indicates that this gesture has been merged with another
51::CODE;;gesture and should be considered discarded.
52::CODE;;:attr:`was_merged` is a
53::CODE;;:class:`~kivy.properties.BooleanProperty`
54::CODE;;`bbox`
55::CODE;;Dictionary with keys minx, miny, maxx, maxy. Represents the size
56::CODE;;of the gesture bounding box.
57::CODE;;:attr:`bbox` is a
58::CODE;;:class:`~kivy.properties.DictProperty`
59::CODE;;`width`
60::CODE;;Represents the width of the gesture.
61::CODE;;:attr:`width` is a
62::CODE;;:class:`~kivy.properties.NumericProperty`
63::CODE;;`height`
64::CODE;;Represents the height of the gesture.
65::CODE;;:attr:`height` is a
66::CODE;;:class:`~kivy.properties.NumericProperty`
67::CODE;;'''
68::CODE;;active = BooleanProperty(True)
69::CODE;;active_strokes = NumericProperty(0)
70::CODE;;max_strokes = NumericProperty(0)
71::CODE;;was_merged = BooleanProperty(False)
72::CODE;;bbox = DictProperty({'minx': float('inf'), 'miny': float('inf'),
73::CODE;;'maxx': float('-inf'), 'maxy': float('-inf')})
74::CODE;;width = NumericProperty(0)
75::CODE;;height = NumericProperty(0)
76::CODE;;def __init__(self, touch, **kwargs):
78::CODE;;self.color = kwargs.pop('color', [1., 1., 1.])
79::CODE;;super(GestureContainer, self).__init__(**kwargs)
81::CODE;;self.id = str(touch.uid)
83::CODE;;self._create_time = Clock.get_time()
84::CODE;;self._update_time = None
85::CODE;;self._cleanup_time = None
86::CODE;;self._cache_time = 0
88::CODE;;self._vectors = None
91::CODE;;self._strokes = {}
93::CODE;;self.update_bbox(touch)
94::CODE;;def get_vectors(self, **kwargs):
95::CODE;;'''Return strokes in a format that is acceptable for
96::CODE;;`kivy.multistroke.Recognizer` as a gesture candidate or template. The
97::CODE;;result is cached automatically; the cache is invalidated at the start
98::CODE;;and end of a stroke and if `update_bbox` is called. If you are going
99::CODE;;to analyze a gesture mid-stroke, you may need to set the `no_cache`
100::CODE;;argument to True.'''
101::CODE;;if self._cache_time == self._update_time and \
102::CODE;;not kwargs.get('no_cache'):
103::CODE;;return self._vectors
104::CODE;;vecs = []
105::CODE;;append = vecs.append
106::CODE;;for tuid, l in self._strokes.items():
107::CODE;;lpts = l.points
108::CODE;;append([Vector(*pts) for pts in zip(lpts[::2], lpts[1::2])])
109::CODE;;self._vectors = vecs
110::CODE;;self._cache_time = self._update_time
111::CODE;;return vecs
112::CODE;;def handles(self, touch):
113::CODE;;'''Returns True if this container handles the given touch'''
114::CODE;;if not self.active:
115::CODE;;return False
116::CODE;;return str(touch.uid) in self._strokes
117::CODE;;def accept_stroke(self, count=1):
118::CODE;;'''Returns True if this container can accept `count` new strokes'''
119::CODE;;if not self.max_strokes:
120::CODE;;return True
121::CODE;;return len(self._strokes) + count <= self.max_strokes
122::CODE;;def update_bbox(self, touch):
123::CODE;;'''Update gesture bbox from a touch coordinate'''
124::CODE;;x, y = touch.x, touch.y
125::CODE;;bb = self.bbox
126::CODE;;if x < bb['minx']:
127::CODE;;bb['minx'] = x
128::CODE;;if y < bb['miny']:
129::CODE;;bb['miny'] = y
130::CODE;;if x > bb['maxx']:
131::CODE;;bb['maxx'] = x
132::CODE;;if y > bb['maxy']:
133::CODE;;bb['maxy'] = y
134::CODE;;self.width = bb['maxx'] - bb['minx']
135::CODE;;self.height = bb['maxy'] - bb['miny']
136::CODE;;self._update_time = Clock.get_time()
137::CODE;;def add_stroke(self, touch, line):
138::CODE;;'''Associate a list of points with a touch.uid; the line itself is
139::CODE;;created by the caller, but subsequent move/up events look it
140::CODE;;up via us. This is done to avoid problems during merge.'''
141::CODE;;self._update_time = Clock.get_time()
142::CODE;;self._strokes[str(touch.uid)] = line
143::CODE;;self.active_strokes += 1
144::CODE;;def complete_stroke(self):
145::CODE;;'''Called on touch up events to keep track of how many strokes
146::CODE;;are active in the gesture (we only want to dispatch event when
147::CODE;;the *last* stroke in the gesture is released)'''
148::CODE;;self._update_time = Clock.get_time()
149::CODE;;self.active_strokes -= 1
150::CODE;;def single_points_test(self):
151::CODE;;'''Returns True if the gesture consists only of single-point strokes,
152::CODE;;we must discard it in this case, or an exception will be raised'''
153::CODE;;for tuid, l in self._strokes.items():
154::CODE;;if len(l.points) > 2:
155::CODE;;return False
156::CODE;;return True
157::CODE;;class GestureSurface(FloatLayout):
158::CODE;;'''Simple gesture surface to track/draw touch movements. Typically used
159::CODE;;to gather user input suitable for :class:`kivy.multistroke.Recognizer`.
160::CODE;;:Properties:
161::CODE;;`temporal_window`
162::CODE;;Time to wait from the last touch_up event before attempting
163::CODE;;to recognize the gesture. If you set this to 0, the
164::CODE;;`on_gesture_complete` event is not fired unless the
165::CODE;;:attr:`max_strokes` condition is met.
166::CODE;;:attr:`temporal_window` is a
167::CODE;;:class:`~kivy.properties.NumericProperty` and defaults to 2.0
168::CODE;;`max_strokes`
169::CODE;;Max number of strokes in a single gesture; if this is reached,
170::CODE;;recognition will start immediately on the final touch_up event.
171::CODE;;If this is set to 0, the `on_gesture_complete` event is not
172::CODE;;fired unless the :attr:`temporal_window` expires.
173::CODE;;:attr:`max_strokes` is a
174::CODE;;:class:`~kivy.properties.NumericProperty` and defaults to 2.0
175::CODE;;`bbox_margin`
176::CODE;;Bounding box margin for detecting gesture collisions, in
177::CODE;;pixels.
178::CODE;;:attr:`bbox_margin` is a
179::CODE;;:class:`~kivy.properties.NumericProperty` and defaults to 30
180::CODE;;`draw_timeout`
181::CODE;;Number of seconds to keep lines/bbox on canvas after the
182::CODE;;`on_gesture_complete` event is fired. If this is set to 0,
183::CODE;;gestures are immediately removed from the surface when
184::CODE;;complete.
185::CODE;;:attr:`draw_timeout` is a
186::CODE;;:class:`~kivy.properties.NumericProperty` and defaults to 3.0
187::CODE;;`color`
188::CODE;;Color used to draw the gesture, in RGB. This option does not
189::CODE;;have an effect if :attr:`use_random_color` is True.
190::CODE;;:attr:`color` is a
191::CODE;;:class:`~kivy.properties.ColorProperty` and defaults to
192::CODE;;[1, 1, 1, 1] (white)
193::CODE;;.. versionchanged:: 2.0.0
194::CODE;;Changed from :class:`~kivy.properties.ListProperty` to
195::CODE;;:class:`~kivy.properties.ColorProperty`.
196::CODE;;`use_random_color`
197::CODE;;Set to True to pick a random color for each gesture, if you do
198::CODE;;this then `color` is ignored. Defaults to False.
199::CODE;;:attr:`use_random_color` is a
200::CODE;;:class:`~kivy.properties.BooleanProperty` and defaults to False
201::CODE;;`line_width`
202::CODE;;Line width used for tracing touches on the surface. Set to 0
203::CODE;;if you only want to detect gestures without drawing anything.
204::CODE;;If you use 1.0, OpenGL GL_LINE is used for drawing; values > 1
205::CODE;;will use an internal drawing method based on triangles (less
206::CODE;;efficient), see :mod:`kivy.graphics`.
207::CODE;;:attr:`line_width` is a
208::CODE;;:class:`~kivy.properties.NumericProperty` and defaults to 2
209::CODE;;`draw_bbox`
210::CODE;;Set to True if you want to draw bounding box behind gestures.
211::CODE;;This only works if `line_width` >= 1. Default is False.
212::CODE;;:attr:`draw_bbox` is a
213::CODE;;:class:`~kivy.properties.BooleanProperty` and defaults to True
214::CODE;;`bbox_alpha`
215::CODE;;Opacity for bounding box if `draw_bbox` is True. Default 0.1
216::CODE;;:attr:`bbox_alpha` is a
217::CODE;;:class:`~kivy.properties.NumericProperty` and defaults to 0.1
218::CODE;;:Events:
219::CODE;;`on_gesture_start` :class:`GestureContainer`
220::CODE;;Fired when a new gesture is initiated on the surface, i.e. the
221::CODE;;first on_touch_down that does not collide with an existing
222::CODE;;gesture on the surface.
223::CODE;;`on_gesture_extend` :class:`GestureContainer`
224::CODE;;Fired when a touch_down event occurs within an existing gesture.
225::CODE;;`on_gesture_merge` :class:`GestureContainer`, :class:`GestureContainer`
226::CODE;;Fired when two gestures collide and get merged to one gesture.
227::CODE;;The first argument is the gesture that has been merged (no longer
228::CODE;;valid); the second is the combined (resulting) gesture.
229::CODE;;`on_gesture_complete` :class:`GestureContainer`
230::CODE;;Fired when a set of strokes is considered a complete gesture,
231::CODE;;this happens when `temporal_window` expires or `max_strokes`
232::CODE;;is reached. Typically you will bind to this event and use
233::CODE;;the provided `GestureContainer` get_vectors() method to
234::CODE;;match against your gesture database.
235::CODE;;`on_gesture_cleanup` :class:`GestureContainer`
236::CODE;;Fired `draw_timeout` seconds after `on_gesture_complete`,
237::CODE;;The gesture will be removed from the canvas (if line_width > 0 or
238::CODE;;draw_bbox is True) and the internal gesture list before this.
239::CODE;;`on_gesture_discard` :class:`GestureContainer`
240::CODE;;Fired when a gesture does not meet the minimum size requirements
241::CODE;;for recognition (width/height < 5, or consists only of single-
242::CODE;;point strokes).
243::CODE;;'''
244::CODE;;temporal_window = NumericProperty(2.0)
245::CODE;;draw_timeout = NumericProperty(3.0)
246::CODE;;max_strokes = NumericProperty(4)
247::CODE;;bbox_margin = NumericProperty(30)
248::CODE;;line_width = NumericProperty(2)
249::CODE;;color = ColorProperty([1., 1., 1., 1.])
250::CODE;;use_random_color = BooleanProperty(False)
251::CODE;;draw_bbox = BooleanProperty(False)
252::CODE;;bbox_alpha = NumericProperty(0.1)
253::CODE;;def __init__(self, **kwargs):
254::CODE;;super(GestureSurface, self).__init__(**kwargs)
256::CODE;;self._gestures = []
257::CODE;;self.register_event_type('on_gesture_start')
258::CODE;;self.register_event_type('on_gesture_extend')
259::CODE;;self.register_event_type('on_gesture_merge')
260::CODE;;self.register_event_type('on_gesture_complete')
261::CODE;;self.register_event_type('on_gesture_cleanup')
262::CODE;;self.register_event_type('on_gesture_discard')
266::CODE;;def on_touch_down(self, touch):
267::CODE;;'''When a new touch is registered, the first thing we do is to test if
268::CODE;;it collides with the bounding box of another known gesture. If so, it
269::CODE;;is assumed to be part of that gesture.
270::CODE;;'''
272::CODE;;if not self.collide_point(touch.x, touch.y):
273::CODE;;return
274::CODE;;touch.grab(self)
276::CODE;;g = self.find_colliding_gesture(touch)
277::CODE;;new = False
278::CODE;;if g is None:
279::CODE;;g = self.init_gesture(touch)
280::CODE;;new = True
282::CODE;;self.init_stroke(g, touch)
283::CODE;;if new:
284::CODE;;self.dispatch('on_gesture_start', g, touch)
285::CODE;;else:
286::CODE;;self.dispatch('on_gesture_extend', g, touch)
287::CODE;;return True
288::CODE;;def on_touch_move(self, touch):
289::CODE;;'''When a touch moves, we add a point to the line on the canvas so the
290::CODE;;path is updated. We must also check if the new point collides with the
291::CODE;;bounding box of another gesture - if so, they should be merged.'''
292::CODE;;if touch.grab_current is not self:
293::CODE;;return
294::CODE;;if not self.collide_point(touch.x, touch.y):
295::CODE;;return
298::CODE;;g = self.get_gesture(touch)
299::CODE;;collision = self.find_colliding_gesture(touch)
300::CODE;;if collision is not None and g.accept_stroke(len(collision._strokes)):
301::CODE;;merge = self.merge_gestures(g, collision)
302::CODE;;if g.was_merged:
303::CODE;;self.dispatch('on_gesture_merge', g, collision)
304::CODE;;else:
305::CODE;;self.dispatch('on_gesture_merge', collision, g)
306::CODE;;g = merge
307::CODE;;else:
308::CODE;;g.update_bbox(touch)
310::CODE;;g._strokes[str(touch.uid)].points += (touch.x, touch.y)
313::CODE;;if self.draw_bbox:
314::CODE;;self._update_canvas_bbox(g)
315::CODE;;return True
316::CODE;;def on_touch_up(self, touch):
317::CODE;;if touch.grab_current is not self:
318::CODE;;return
319::CODE;;touch.ungrab(self)
320::CODE;;g = self.get_gesture(touch)
321::CODE;;g.complete_stroke()
323::CODE;;if not g.accept_stroke():
324::CODE;;self._complete_dispatcher(0)
326::CODE;;elif self.temporal_window > 0:
327::CODE;;Clock.schedule_once(self._complete_dispatcher,
328::CODE;;self.temporal_window)
332::CODE;;def init_gesture(self, touch):
333::CODE;;'''Create a new gesture from touch, i.e. it's the first on
334::CODE;;surface, or was not close enough to any existing gesture (yet)'''
335::CODE;;col = self.color
336::CODE;;if self.use_random_color:
337::CODE;;col = hsv_to_rgb(random(), 1., 1.)
338::CODE;;g = GestureContainer(touch, max_strokes=self.max_strokes, color=col)
340::CODE;;if self.draw_bbox:
341::CODE;;bb = g.bbox
342::CODE;;with self.canvas:
343::CODE;;Color(col[0], col[1], col[2], self.bbox_alpha, mode='rgba',
344::CODE;;group=g.id)
345::CODE;;g._bbrect = Rectangle(
346::CODE;;group=g.id,
347::CODE;;pos=(bb['minx'], bb['miny']),
348::CODE;;size=(bb['maxx'] - bb['minx'],
349::CODE;;bb['maxy'] - bb['miny']))
350::CODE;;self._gestures.append(g)
351::CODE;;return g
352::CODE;;def init_stroke(self, g, touch):
353::CODE;;points = [touch.x, touch.y]
354::CODE;;col = g.color
355::CODE;;new_line = Line(
356::CODE;;points=points,
357::CODE;;width=self.line_width,
358::CODE;;group=g.id)
359::CODE;;g._strokes[str(touch.uid)] = new_line
360::CODE;;if self.line_width:
361::CODE;;canvas_add = self.canvas.add
362::CODE;;canvas_add(Color(col[0], col[1], col[2], mode='rgb', group=g.id))
363::CODE;;canvas_add(new_line)
366::CODE;;g.update_bbox(touch)
367::CODE;;if self.draw_bbox:
368::CODE;;self._update_canvas_bbox(g)
370::CODE;;g.add_stroke(touch, new_line)
371::CODE;;def get_gesture(self, touch):
372::CODE;;'''Returns GestureContainer associated with given touch'''
373::CODE;;for g in self._gestures:
374::CODE;;if g.active and g.handles(touch):
375::CODE;;return g
376::CODE;;raise Exception('get_gesture() failed to identify ' + str(touch.uid))
377::CODE;;def find_colliding_gesture(self, touch):
378::CODE;;'''Checks if a touch x/y collides with the bounding box of an existing
379::CODE;;gesture. If so, return it (otherwise returns None)
380::CODE;;'''
381::CODE;;touch_x, touch_y = touch.pos
382::CODE;;for g in self._gestures:
383::CODE;;if g.active and not g.handles(touch) and g.accept_stroke():
384::CODE;;bb = g.bbox
385::CODE;;margin = self.bbox_margin
386::CODE;;minx = bb['minx'] - margin
387::CODE;;miny = bb['miny'] - margin
388::CODE;;maxx = bb['maxx'] + margin
389::CODE;;maxy = bb['maxy'] + margin
390::CODE;;if minx <= touch_x <= maxx and miny <= touch_y <= maxy:
391::CODE;;return g
392::CODE;;return None
393::CODE;;def merge_gestures(self, g, other):
394::CODE;;'''Merges two gestures together, the oldest one is retained and the
395::CODE;;newer one gets the `GestureContainer.was_merged` flag raised.'''
398::CODE;;swap = other._create_time < g._create_time
399::CODE;;a = swap and other or g
400::CODE;;b = swap and g or other
402::CODE;;abbox = a.bbox
403::CODE;;bbbox = b.bbox
404::CODE;;if bbbox['minx'] < abbox['minx']:
405::CODE;;abbox['minx'] = bbbox['minx']
406::CODE;;if bbbox['miny'] < abbox['miny']:
407::CODE;;abbox['miny'] = bbbox['miny']
408::CODE;;if bbbox['maxx'] > abbox['maxx']:
409::CODE;;abbox['maxx'] = bbbox['maxx']
410::CODE;;if bbbox['maxy'] > abbox['maxy']:
411::CODE;;abbox['maxy'] = bbbox['maxy']
414::CODE;;astrokes = a._strokes
415::CODE;;lw = self.line_width
416::CODE;;a_id = a.id
417::CODE;;col = a.color
418::CODE;;self.canvas.remove_group(b.id)
419::CODE;;canv_add = self.canvas.add
420::CODE;;for uid, old in b._strokes.items():
422::CODE;;new_line = Line(
423::CODE;;points=old.points,
424::CODE;;width=old.width,
425::CODE;;group=a_id)
426::CODE;;astrokes[uid] = new_line
427::CODE;;if lw:
428::CODE;;canv_add(Color(col[0], col[1], col[2], mode='rgb', group=a_id))
429::CODE;;canv_add(new_line)
430::CODE;;b.active = False
431::CODE;;b.was_merged = True
432::CODE;;a.active_strokes += b.active_strokes
433::CODE;;a._update_time = Clock.get_time()
434::CODE;;return a
435::CODE;;def _update_canvas_bbox(self, g):
438::CODE;;if not hasattr(g, '_bbrect'):
439::CODE;;return
440::CODE;;bb = g.bbox
441::CODE;;g._bbrect.pos = (bb['minx'], bb['miny'])
442::CODE;;g._bbrect.size = (bb['maxx'] - bb['minx'],
443::CODE;;bb['maxy'] - bb['miny'])
447::CODE;;def _complete_dispatcher(self, dt):
448::CODE;;'''This method is scheduled on all touch up events. It will dispatch
449::CODE;;the `on_gesture_complete` event for all completed gestures, and remove
450::CODE;;merged gestures from the internal gesture list.'''
451::CODE;;need_cleanup = False
452::CODE;;gest = self._gestures
453::CODE;;timeout = self.draw_timeout
454::CODE;;twin = self.temporal_window
455::CODE;;get_time = Clock.get_time
456::CODE;;for idx, g in enumerate(gest):
458::CODE;;if g.was_merged:
459::CODE;;del gest[idx]
460::CODE;;continue
463::CODE;;if not g.active or g.active_strokes != 0:
464::CODE;;continue
465::CODE;;t1 = g._update_time + twin
466::CODE;;t2 = get_time() + UNDERSHOOT_MARGIN
469::CODE;;if not g.accept_stroke() or t1 <= t2:
470::CODE;;discard = False
471::CODE;;if g.width < 5 and g.height < 5:
472::CODE;;discard = True
473::CODE;;elif g.single_points_test():
474::CODE;;discard = True
475::CODE;;need_cleanup = True
476::CODE;;g.active = False
477::CODE;;g._cleanup_time = get_time() + timeout
478::CODE;;if discard:
479::CODE;;self.dispatch('on_gesture_discard', g)
480::CODE;;else:
481::CODE;;self.dispatch('on_gesture_complete', g)
482::CODE;;if need_cleanup:
483::CODE;;Clock.schedule_once(self._cleanup, timeout)
484::CODE;;def _cleanup(self, dt):
485::CODE;;'''This method is scheduled from _complete_dispatcher to clean up the
486::CODE;;canvas and internal gesture list after a gesture is completed.'''
487::CODE;;m = UNDERSHOOT_MARGIN
488::CODE;;rg = self.canvas.remove_group
489::CODE;;gestures = self._gestures
490::CODE;;for idx, g in enumerate(gestures):
491::CODE;;if g._cleanup_time is None:
492::CODE;;continue
493::CODE;;if g._cleanup_time <= Clock.get_time() + m:
494::CODE;;rg(g.id)
495::CODE;;del gestures[idx]
496::CODE;;self.dispatch('on_gesture_cleanup', g)

1::CODE;;'''
2::CODE;;Grid Layout
3::CODE;;===========
4::CODE;;.. only:: html
5::CODE;;.. image:: images/gridlayout.gif
6::CODE;;:align: right
7::CODE;;.. only:: latex
8::CODE;;.. image:: images/gridlayout.png
9::CODE;;:align: right
10::CODE;;.. versionadded:: 1.0.4
11::CODE;;The :class:`GridLayout` arranges children in a matrix. It takes the available
12::CODE;;space and divides it into columns and rows, then adds widgets to the resulting
13::CODE;;"cells".
14::CODE;;.. versionchanged:: 1.0.7
15::CODE;;The implementation has changed to use the widget size_hint for calculating
16::CODE;;column/row sizes. `uniform_width` and `uniform_height` have been removed
17::CODE;;and other properties have added to give you more control.
18::CODE;;Background
19::CODE;;----------
20::CODE;;Unlike many other toolkits, you cannot explicitly place a widget in a specific
21::CODE;;column/row. Each child is automatically assigned a position determined by the
22::CODE;;layout configuration and the child's index in the children list.
23::CODE;;A GridLayout must always have at least one input constraint:
24::CODE;;:attr:`GridLayout.cols` or :attr:`GridLayout.rows`. If you do not specify cols
25::CODE;;or rows, the Layout will throw an exception.
26::CODE;;Column Width and Row Height
27::CODE;;---------------------------
28::CODE;;The column width/row height are determined in 3 steps:
29::CODE;;- The initial size is given by the :attr:`col_default_width` and
30::CODE;;:attr:`row_default_height` properties. To customize the size of a single
31::CODE;;column or row, use :attr:`cols_minimum` or :attr:`rows_minimum`.
32::CODE;;- The `size_hint_x`/`size_hint_y` of the children are taken into account.
33::CODE;;If no widgets have a size hint, the maximum size is used for all
34::CODE;;children.
35::CODE;;- You can force the default size by setting the :attr:`col_force_default`
36::CODE;;or :attr:`row_force_default` property. This will force the layout to
37::CODE;;ignore the `width` and `size_hint` properties of children and use the
38::CODE;;default size.
39::CODE;;Using a GridLayout
40::CODE;;------------------
41::CODE;;In the example below, all widgets will have an equal size. By default, the
42::CODE;;`size_hint` is (1, 1), so a Widget will take the full size of the parent::
43::CODE;;layout = GridLayout(cols=2)
44::CODE;;layout.add_widget(Button(text='Hello 1'))
45::CODE;;layout.add_widget(Button(text='World 1'))
46::CODE;;layout.add_widget(Button(text='Hello 2'))
47::CODE;;layout.add_widget(Button(text='World 2'))
48::CODE;;.. image:: images/gridlayout_1.jpg
49::CODE;;Now, let's fix the size of Hello buttons to 100px instead of using
50::CODE;;size_hint_x=1::
51::CODE;;layout = GridLayout(cols=2)
52::CODE;;layout.add_widget(Button(text='Hello 1', size_hint_x=None, width=100))
53::CODE;;layout.add_widget(Button(text='World 1'))
54::CODE;;layout.add_widget(Button(text='Hello 2', size_hint_x=None, width=100))
55::CODE;;layout.add_widget(Button(text='World 2'))
56::CODE;;.. image:: images/gridlayout_2.jpg
57::CODE;;Next, let's fix the row height to a specific size::
58::CODE;;layout = GridLayout(cols=2, row_force_default=True, row_default_height=40)
59::CODE;;layout.add_widget(Button(text='Hello 1', size_hint_x=None, width=100))
60::CODE;;layout.add_widget(Button(text='World 1'))
61::CODE;;layout.add_widget(Button(text='Hello 2', size_hint_x=None, width=100))
62::CODE;;layout.add_widget(Button(text='World 2'))
63::CODE;;.. image:: images/gridlayout_3.jpg
64::CODE;;'''
65::CODE;;__all__ = ('GridLayout', 'GridLayoutException')
66::CODE;;from kivy.logger import Logger
67::CODE;;from kivy.uix.layout import Layout
68::CODE;;from kivy.properties import NumericProperty, BooleanProperty, DictProperty, \
69::CODE;;BoundedNumericProperty, ReferenceListProperty, VariableListProperty, \
70::CODE;;ObjectProperty, StringProperty, OptionProperty
71::CODE;;from math import ceil
72::CODE;;from itertools import accumulate, product, chain, islice
73::CODE;;from operator import sub
74::CODE;;def nmax(*args):
76::CODE;;args = [x for x in args if x is not None]
77::CODE;;return max(args)
78::CODE;;def nmin(*args):
80::CODE;;args = [x for x in args if x is not None]
81::CODE;;return min(args)
82::CODE;;class GridLayoutException(Exception):
83::CODE;;'''Exception for errors if the grid layout manipulation fails.
84::CODE;;'''

88::CODE;;'''
89::CODE;;spacing = VariableListProperty([0, 0], length=2)

91::CODE;;spacing also accepts a one argument form [spacing].

106::CODE;;'''Number of columns in the grid.

109::CODE;;longer set this to a negative value.

117::CODE;;longer set this to a negative value.

139::CODE;;'''

146::CODE;;'''
147::CODE;;cols_minimum = DictProperty({})

149::CODE;;column numbers, e.g. 0, 1, 2...
150::CODE;;.. versionadded:: 1.0.7

152::CODE;;defaults to {}.
153::CODE;;'''
154::CODE;;rows_minimum = DictProperty({})
155::CODE;;'''Dict of minimum height for each row. The dictionary keys are the
156::CODE;;row numbers, e.g. 0, 1, 2...
157::CODE;;.. versionadded:: 1.0.7
158::CODE;;:attr:`rows_minimum` is a :class:`~kivy.properties.DictProperty` and
159::CODE;;defaults to {}.
160::CODE;;'''
161::CODE;;minimum_width = NumericProperty(0)
162::CODE;;'''Automatically computed minimum width needed to contain all children.
163::CODE;;.. versionadded:: 1.0.8
164::CODE;;:attr:`minimum_width` is a :class:`~kivy.properties.NumericProperty` and
165::CODE;;defaults to 0. It is read only.
166::CODE;;'''
167::CODE;;minimum_height = NumericProperty(0)
168::CODE;;'''Automatically computed minimum height needed to contain all children.
169::CODE;;.. versionadded:: 1.0.8
170::CODE;;:attr:`minimum_height` is a :class:`~kivy.properties.NumericProperty` and
171::CODE;;defaults to 0. It is read only.
172::CODE;;'''
173::CODE;;minimum_size = ReferenceListProperty(minimum_width, minimum_height)
174::CODE;;'''Automatically computed minimum size needed to contain all children.
175::CODE;;.. versionadded:: 1.0.8
176::CODE;;:attr:`minimum_size` is a
177::CODE;;:class:`~kivy.properties.ReferenceListProperty` of
178::CODE;;(:attr:`minimum_width`, :attr:`minimum_height`) properties. It is read
179::CODE;;only.
180::CODE;;'''
181::CODE;;orientation = OptionProperty('lr-tb', options=(
182::CODE;;'lr-tb', 'tb-lr', 'rl-tb', 'tb-rl', 'lr-bt', 'bt-lr', 'rl-bt',
183::CODE;;'bt-rl'))

185::CODE;;:attr:`orientation` is an :class:`~kivy.properties.OptionProperty` and
186::CODE;;defaults to 'lr-tb'.
187::CODE;;Valid orientations are 'lr-tb', 'tb-lr', 'rl-tb', 'tb-rl', 'lr-bt',

235::CODE;;def _init_rows_cols_sizes(self, count):
238::CODE;;current_cols = self.cols
239::CODE;;current_rows = self.rows
242::CODE;;if not current_cols and not current_rows:
243::CODE;;Logger.warning('%r have no cols or rows set, '
244::CODE;;'layout is not triggered.' % self)
245::CODE;;return
246::CODE;;if current_cols is None:
247::CODE;;current_cols = int(ceil(count / float(current_rows)))
248::CODE;;elif current_rows is None:
249::CODE;;current_rows = int(ceil(count / float(current_cols)))
250::CODE;;current_cols = max(1, current_cols)
251::CODE;;current_rows = max(1, current_rows)
252::CODE;;self._has_hint_bound_x = False
253::CODE;;self._has_hint_bound_y = False
256::CODE;;self._cols = cols = [self.col_default_width] * current_cols
257::CODE;;self._cols_sh = [None] * current_cols
258::CODE;;self._cols_sh_min = [None] * current_cols
259::CODE;;self._cols_sh_max = [None] * current_cols
260::CODE;;self._rows = rows = [self.row_default_height] * current_rows
261::CODE;;self._rows_sh = [None] * current_rows
262::CODE;;self._rows_sh_min = [None] * current_rows
263::CODE;;self._rows_sh_max = [None] * current_rows
265::CODE;;items = (i for i in self.cols_minimum.items() if i[0] < len(cols))
266::CODE;;for index, value in items:
267::CODE;;cols[index] = max(value, cols[index])
268::CODE;;items = (i for i in self.rows_minimum.items() if i[0] < len(rows))
269::CODE;;for index, value in items:
270::CODE;;rows[index] = max(value, rows[index])
271::CODE;;return True
272::CODE;;def _fill_rows_cols_sizes(self):
273::CODE;;cols, rows = self._cols, self._rows
274::CODE;;cols_sh, rows_sh = self._cols_sh, self._rows_sh
275::CODE;;cols_sh_min, rows_sh_min = self._cols_sh_min, self._rows_sh_min
276::CODE;;cols_sh_max, rows_sh_max = self._cols_sh_max, self._rows_sh_max
278::CODE;;has_bound_y = has_bound_x = False
279::CODE;;idx_iter = self._create_idx_iter(len(cols), len(rows))
280::CODE;;for child, (col, row) in zip(reversed(self.children), idx_iter):
281::CODE;;(shw, shh), (w, h) = child.size_hint, child.size
282::CODE;;shw_min, shh_min = child.size_hint_min
283::CODE;;shw_max, shh_max = child.size_hint_max
285::CODE;;if shw is None:
286::CODE;;cols[col] = nmax(cols[col], w)
287::CODE;;else:
288::CODE;;cols_sh[col] = nmax(cols_sh[col], shw)
289::CODE;;if shw_min is not None:
290::CODE;;has_bound_x = True
291::CODE;;cols_sh_min[col] = nmax(cols_sh_min[col], shw_min)
292::CODE;;if shw_max is not None:
293::CODE;;has_bound_x = True
294::CODE;;cols_sh_max[col] = nmin(cols_sh_max[col], shw_max)
295::CODE;;if shh is None:
296::CODE;;rows[row] = nmax(rows[row], h)
297::CODE;;else:
298::CODE;;rows_sh[row] = nmax(rows_sh[row], shh)
299::CODE;;if shh_min is not None:
300::CODE;;has_bound_y = True
301::CODE;;rows_sh_min[row] = nmax(rows_sh_min[row], shh_min)
302::CODE;;if shh_max is not None:
303::CODE;;has_bound_y = True
304::CODE;;rows_sh_max[row] = nmin(rows_sh_max[row], shh_max)
305::CODE;;self._has_hint_bound_x = has_bound_x
306::CODE;;self._has_hint_bound_y = has_bound_y
307::CODE;;def _update_minimum_size(self):
310::CODE;;l, t, r, b = self.padding
311::CODE;;spacing_x, spacing_y = self.spacing
312::CODE;;cols, rows = self._cols, self._rows
313::CODE;;width = l + r + spacing_x * (len(cols) - 1)
314::CODE;;self._cols_min_size_none = sum(cols) + width
320::CODE;;if self._has_hint_bound_x:
321::CODE;;cols_sh_min = self._cols_sh_min
322::CODE;;cols_sh_max = self._cols_sh_max
323::CODE;;for i, (c, sh_min, sh_max) in enumerate(
324::CODE;;zip(cols, cols_sh_min, cols_sh_max)):
325::CODE;;if sh_min is not None:
326::CODE;;width += max(c, sh_min)
327::CODE;;cols_sh_min[i] = max(0., sh_min - c)
328::CODE;;else:
329::CODE;;width += c
330::CODE;;if sh_max is not None:
331::CODE;;cols_sh_max[i] = max(0., sh_max - c)
332::CODE;;else:
333::CODE;;width = self._cols_min_size_none
334::CODE;;height = t + b + spacing_y * (len(rows) - 1)
335::CODE;;self._rows_min_size_none = sum(rows) + height
336::CODE;;if self._has_hint_bound_y:
337::CODE;;rows_sh_min = self._rows_sh_min
338::CODE;;rows_sh_max = self._rows_sh_max
339::CODE;;for i, (r, sh_min, sh_max) in enumerate(
340::CODE;;zip(rows, rows_sh_min, rows_sh_max)):
341::CODE;;if sh_min is not None:
342::CODE;;height += max(r, sh_min)
343::CODE;;rows_sh_min[i] = max(0., sh_min - r)
344::CODE;;else:
345::CODE;;height += r
346::CODE;;if sh_max is not None:
347::CODE;;rows_sh_max[i] = max(0., sh_max - r)
348::CODE;;else:
349::CODE;;height = self._rows_min_size_none
351::CODE;;self.minimum_size = (width, height)
352::CODE;;def _finalize_rows_cols_sizes(self):
353::CODE;;selfw = self.width
354::CODE;;selfh = self.height
356::CODE;;if self.col_force_default:
357::CODE;;cols = [self.col_default_width] * len(self._cols)
358::CODE;;for index, value in self.cols_minimum.items():
359::CODE;;cols[index] = value
360::CODE;;self._cols = cols
361::CODE;;else:
362::CODE;;cols = self._cols
363::CODE;;cols_sh = self._cols_sh
364::CODE;;cols_sh_min = self._cols_sh_min
365::CODE;;cols_weight = float(sum((x for x in cols_sh if x is not None)))
366::CODE;;stretch_w = max(0., selfw - self._cols_min_size_none)
367::CODE;;if stretch_w > 1e-9:
368::CODE;;if self._has_hint_bound_x:
370::CODE;;self.layout_hint_with_bounds(
371::CODE;;cols_weight, stretch_w,
372::CODE;;sum((c for c in cols_sh_min if c is not None)),
373::CODE;;cols_sh_min, self._cols_sh_max, cols_sh)
374::CODE;;for index, col_stretch in enumerate(cols_sh):
376::CODE;;if not col_stretch:
377::CODE;;continue
379::CODE;;cols[index] += stretch_w * col_stretch / cols_weight
381::CODE;;if self.row_force_default:
382::CODE;;rows = [self.row_default_height] * len(self._rows)
383::CODE;;for index, value in self.rows_minimum.items():
384::CODE;;rows[index] = value
385::CODE;;self._rows = rows
386::CODE;;else:
387::CODE;;rows = self._rows
388::CODE;;rows_sh = self._rows_sh
389::CODE;;rows_sh_min = self._rows_sh_min
390::CODE;;rows_weight = float(sum((x for x in rows_sh if x is not None)))
391::CODE;;stretch_h = max(0., selfh - self._rows_min_size_none)
392::CODE;;if stretch_h > 1e-9:
393::CODE;;if self._has_hint_bound_y:
395::CODE;;self.layout_hint_with_bounds(
396::CODE;;rows_weight, stretch_h,
397::CODE;;sum((r for r in rows_sh_min if r is not None)),
398::CODE;;rows_sh_min, self._rows_sh_max, rows_sh)
399::CODE;;for index, row_stretch in enumerate(rows_sh):
401::CODE;;if not row_stretch:
402::CODE;;continue
404::CODE;;rows[index] += stretch_h * row_stretch / rows_weight
405::CODE;;def _iterate_layout(self, count):
406::CODE;;orientation = self.orientation
407::CODE;;padding = self.padding
408::CODE;;spacing_x, spacing_y = self.spacing
409::CODE;;cols = self._cols
410::CODE;;if self._fills_from_left_to_right:
411::CODE;;x_iter = accumulate(chain(
412::CODE;;(self.x + padding[0], ),
413::CODE;;(
414::CODE;;col_width + spacing_x
415::CODE;;for col_width in islice(cols, len(cols) - 1)
416::CODE;;),
417::CODE;;))
418::CODE;;else:
419::CODE;;x_iter = accumulate(chain(
420::CODE;;(self.right - padding[2] - cols[-1], ),
421::CODE;;(
422::CODE;;col_width + spacing_x
423::CODE;;for col_width in islice(reversed(cols), 1, None)
424::CODE;;),
425::CODE;;), sub)
426::CODE;;cols = reversed(cols)
427::CODE;;rows = self._rows
428::CODE;;if self._fills_from_top_to_bottom:
429::CODE;;y_iter = accumulate(chain(
430::CODE;;(self.top - padding[1] - rows[0], ),
431::CODE;;(
432::CODE;;row_height + spacing_y
433::CODE;;for row_height in islice(rows, 1, None)
434::CODE;;),
435::CODE;;), sub)
436::CODE;;else:
437::CODE;;y_iter = accumulate(chain(
438::CODE;;(self.y + padding[3], ),
439::CODE;;(
440::CODE;;row_height + spacing_y
441::CODE;;for row_height in islice(reversed(rows), len(rows) - 1)
442::CODE;;),
443::CODE;;))
444::CODE;;rows = reversed(rows)
445::CODE;;if self._fills_row_first:
446::CODE;;for i, (y, x), (row_height, col_width) in zip(
447::CODE;;reversed(range(count)),
448::CODE;;product(y_iter, x_iter),
449::CODE;;product(rows, cols)):
450::CODE;;yield i, x, y, col_width, row_height
451::CODE;;else:
452::CODE;;for i, (x, y), (col_width, row_height) in zip(
453::CODE;;reversed(range(count)),
454::CODE;;product(x_iter, y_iter),
455::CODE;;product(cols, rows)):
456::CODE;;yield i, x, y, col_width, row_height
457::CODE;;def do_layout(self, *largs):
458::CODE;;children = self.children
459::CODE;;if not children or not self._init_rows_cols_sizes(len(children)):
460::CODE;;l, t, r, b = self.padding
461::CODE;;self.minimum_size = l + r, t + b
462::CODE;;return
463::CODE;;self._fill_rows_cols_sizes()
464::CODE;;self._update_minimum_size()
465::CODE;;self._finalize_rows_cols_sizes()
466::CODE;;for i, x, y, w, h in self._iterate_layout(len(children)):
467::CODE;;c = children[i]
468::CODE;;c.pos = x, y
469::CODE;;shw, shh = c.size_hint
470::CODE;;shw_min, shh_min = c.size_hint_min
471::CODE;;shw_max, shh_max = c.size_hint_max
472::CODE;;if shw_min is not None:
473::CODE;;if shw_max is not None:
474::CODE;;w = max(min(w, shw_max), shw_min)
475::CODE;;else:
476::CODE;;w = max(w, shw_min)
477::CODE;;else:
478::CODE;;if shw_max is not None:
479::CODE;;w = min(w, shw_max)
480::CODE;;if shh_min is not None:
481::CODE;;if shh_max is not None:
482::CODE;;h = max(min(h, shh_max), shh_min)
483::CODE;;else:
484::CODE;;h = max(h, shh_min)
485::CODE;;else:
486::CODE;;if shh_max is not None:
487::CODE;;h = min(h, shh_max)
488::CODE;;if shw is None:
489::CODE;;if shh is not None:
490::CODE;;c.height = h
491::CODE;;else:
492::CODE;;if shh is None:
493::CODE;;c.width = w
494::CODE;;else:
495::CODE;;c.size = (w, h)
496::CODE;;def _create_idx_iter(self, n_cols, n_rows):
497::CODE;;col_indices = range(n_cols) if self._fills_from_left_to_right \
498::CODE;;else range(n_cols - 1, -1, -1)
499::CODE;;row_indices = range(n_rows) if self._fills_from_top_to_bottom \
500::CODE;;else range(n_rows - 1, -1, -1)
501::CODE;;if self._fills_row_first:
502::CODE;;return (
503::CODE;;(col_index, row_index)
504::CODE;;for row_index, col_index in product(row_indices, col_indices))
505::CODE;;else:
506::CODE;;return product(col_indices, row_indices)
1::CODE;;'''
2::CODE;;Image
3::CODE;;=====
4::CODE;;The :class:`Image` widget is used to display an image::
5::CODE;;Example in python::
6::CODE;;wimg = Image(source='mylogo.png')
7::CODE;;Kv Example::
8::CODE;;Image:
9::CODE;;source: 'mylogo.png'
10::CODE;;size: self.texture_size
11::CODE;;Asynchronous Loading
12::CODE;;--------------------
13::CODE;;To load an image asynchronously (for example from an external webserver), use
14::CODE;;the :class:`AsyncImage` subclass::
15::CODE;;aimg = AsyncImage(source='http://mywebsite.com/logo.png')
16::CODE;;This can be useful as it prevents your application from waiting until the image
17::CODE;;is loaded. If you want to display large images or retrieve them from URL's,
18::CODE;;using :class:`AsyncImage` will allow these resources to be retrieved on a
19::CODE;;background thread without blocking your application.
20::CODE;;Alignment
21::CODE;;---------
22::CODE;;By default, the image is centered inside the widget bounding box.
23::CODE;;Adjustment
24::CODE;;----------
25::CODE;;To control how the image should be adjusted to fit inside the widget box, you
26::CODE;;should use the :attr:`~kivy.uix.image.Image.fit_mode` property. Available
27::CODE;;options include:
28::CODE;;- ``"scale-down"``: maintains aspect ratio without stretching.
29::CODE;;- ``"fill"``: stretches to fill widget, may cause distortion.
30::CODE;;- ``"contain"``: maintains aspect ratio and resizes to fit inside widget.
31::CODE;;- ``"cover"``: maintains aspect ratio and stretches to fill widget, may clip
32::CODE;;image.
33::CODE;;For more details, refer to the :attr:`~kivy.uix.image.Image.fit_mode`.
34::CODE;;You can also inherit from Image and create your own style. For example, if you
35::CODE;;want your image to be greater than the size of your widget, you could do::
36::CODE;;class FullImage(Image):
37::CODE;;pass
38::CODE;;And in your kivy language file::
39::CODE;;<-FullImage>:
40::CODE;;canvas:
41::CODE;;Color:
42::CODE;;rgb: (1, 1, 1)
43::CODE;;Rectangle:
44::CODE;;texture: self.texture
45::CODE;;size: self.width + 20, self.height + 20
46::CODE;;pos: self.x - 10, self.y - 10
47::CODE;;'''
48::CODE;;__all__ = ('Image', 'AsyncImage')
49::CODE;;from kivy.uix.widget import Widget

88::CODE;;up-to-date. Use self.texture.size instead.

90::CODE;;def get_image_ratio(self):
91::CODE;;if self.texture:
92::CODE;;return self.texture.width / float(self.texture.height)
93::CODE;;return 1.0
94::CODE;;mipmap = BooleanProperty(False)

106::CODE;;color = ColorProperty([1, 1, 1, 1])

108::CODE;;'tint' an image. Be careful: if the source image is not gray/white, the
109::CODE;;color will not really work as expected.
110::CODE;;.. versionadded:: 1.0.6
