406::CODE;;class reify(object):
407::CODE;;'''
408::CODE;;Put the result of a method which uses this (non-data) descriptor decorator
409::CODE;;in the instance dict after the first call, effectively replacing the
410::CODE;;decorator with an instance variable.
411::CODE;;It acts like @property, except that the function is only ever called once;
412::CODE;;after that, the value is cached as a regular attribute. This gives you lazy
413::CODE;;attribute creation on objects that are meant to be immutable.
414::CODE;;Taken from the `Pyramid project <https://pypi.python.org/pypi/pyramid/>`_.
415::CODE;;To use this as a decorator::
416::CODE;;@reify
417::CODE;;def lazy(self):
418::CODE;;...
419::CODE;;return hard_to_compute_int
422::CODE;;'''
423::CODE;;def __init__(self, func):
424::CODE;;self.func = func
425::CODE;;self.__doc__ = func.__doc__
426::CODE;;def __get__(self, inst, cls):
427::CODE;;if inst is None:
428::CODE;;return self
429::CODE;;retval = self.func(inst)
430::CODE;;setattr(inst, self.func.__name__, retval)
431::CODE;;return retval
432::CODE;;def _get_pi_version():
438::CODE;;if not path.isfile('/proc/cpuinfo'):
439::CODE;;return None
440::CODE;;with open('/proc/cpuinfo', 'r') as f:
441::CODE;;cpuinfo = f.read()
443::CODE;;revision = search(r'^Revision\s+:\s+(\w+)$', cpuinfo,
444::CODE;;flags=MULTILINE | IGNORECASE)
445::CODE;;if not revision:
447::CODE;;return None
450::CODE;;revision = int(revision.group(1), base=16)
451::CODE;;if revision & 0x800000:
452::CODE;;return ((revision & 0xF000) >> 12) + 1
455::CODE;;return 1
456::CODE;;pi_version = _get_pi_version()
1::CODE;;'''Vector
2::CODE;;======
3::CODE;;The :class:`Vector` represents a 2D vector (x, y).
4::CODE;;Our implementation is built on top of a Python list.
5::CODE;;An example of constructing a Vector::
7::CODE;;>>> v = Vector(82, 34)
8::CODE;;>>> v[0]
9::CODE;;82
10::CODE;;>>> v.x
11::CODE;;82
12::CODE;;>>> v[1]
13::CODE;;34
14::CODE;;>>> v.y
15::CODE;;34
17::CODE;;>>> pos = (93, 45)
18::CODE;;>>> v = Vector(pos)
19::CODE;;>>> v[0]
20::CODE;;93
21::CODE;;>>> v.x
22::CODE;;93
23::CODE;;>>> v[1]
24::CODE;;45
25::CODE;;>>> v.y
26::CODE;;45
27::CODE;;Optimized usage
28::CODE;;---------------
29::CODE;;Most of the time, you can use a list for arguments instead of using a
30::CODE;;Vector. For example, if you want to calculate the distance between 2
31::CODE;;points::
32::CODE;;a = (10, 10)
33::CODE;;b = (87, 34)
35::CODE;;print('distance between a and b:', Vector(a).distance(b))
37::CODE;;va = Vector(a)
38::CODE;;vb = Vector(b)
39::CODE;;print('distance between a and b:', va.distance(vb))
40::CODE;;Vector operators
41::CODE;;----------------
42::CODE;;The :class:`Vector` supports some numeric operators such as +, -, /::
43::CODE;;>>> Vector(1, 1) + Vector(9, 5)
44::CODE;;[10, 6]
45::CODE;;>>> Vector(9, 5) - Vector(5, 5)
46::CODE;;[4, 0]
47::CODE;;>>> Vector(10, 10) / Vector(2., 4.)
48::CODE;;[5.0, 2.5]
49::CODE;;>>> Vector(10, 10) / 5.
50::CODE;;[2.0, 2.0]
51::CODE;;You can also use in-place operators::
52::CODE;;>>> v = Vector(1, 1)
53::CODE;;>>> v += 2
54::CODE;;>>> v
55::CODE;;[3, 3]
56::CODE;;>>> v *= 5
57::CODE;;[15, 15]
58::CODE;;>>> v /= 2.
59::CODE;;[7.5, 7.5]
60::CODE;;'''
61::CODE;;__all__ = ('Vector', )
62::CODE;;import math
63::CODE;;class Vector(list):
64::CODE;;'''Vector class. See module documentation for more information.
65::CODE;;'''
66::CODE;;def __init__(self, *largs):
67::CODE;;if len(largs) == 1:
68::CODE;;super(Vector, self).__init__(largs[0])
69::CODE;;elif len(largs) == 2:
70::CODE;;super(Vector, self).__init__(largs)
71::CODE;;else:
72::CODE;;raise Exception('Invalid vector')
73::CODE;;def _get_x(self):
74::CODE;;return self[0]
75::CODE;;def _set_x(self, x):
76::CODE;;self[0] = x
77::CODE;;x = property(_get_x, _set_x)
78::CODE;;''':attr:`x` represents the first element in the list.
79::CODE;;>>> v = Vector(12, 23)
80::CODE;;>>> v[0]
81::CODE;;12
82::CODE;;>>> v.x
83::CODE;;12
84::CODE;;'''
85::CODE;;def _get_y(self):
86::CODE;;return self[1]
87::CODE;;def _set_y(self, y):
88::CODE;;self[1] = y
89::CODE;;y = property(_get_y, _set_y)
90::CODE;;''':attr:`y` represents the second element in the list.
91::CODE;;>>> v = Vector(12, 23)
92::CODE;;>>> v[1]
93::CODE;;23
94::CODE;;>>> v.y
95::CODE;;23
96::CODE;;'''
97::CODE;;def __getslice__(self, i, j):
98::CODE;;try:
101::CODE;;return Vector(super(Vector, self).__getslice__(i, j))
102::CODE;;except Exception:
103::CODE;;raise TypeError('vector::FAILURE in __getslice__')
104::CODE;;def __add__(self, val):
105::CODE;;return Vector(list(map(lambda x, y: x + y, self, val)))
106::CODE;;def __iadd__(self, val):
107::CODE;;if type(val) in (int, float):
108::CODE;;self.x += val
109::CODE;;self.y += val
110::CODE;;else:
111::CODE;;self.x += val.x
112::CODE;;self.y += val.y
113::CODE;;return self
114::CODE;;def __neg__(self):
115::CODE;;return Vector([-x for x in self])
116::CODE;;def __sub__(self, val):
117::CODE;;return Vector(list(map(lambda x, y: x - y, self, val)))
118::CODE;;def __isub__(self, val):
119::CODE;;if type(val) in (int, float):
120::CODE;;self.x -= val
121::CODE;;self.y -= val
122::CODE;;else:
123::CODE;;self.x -= val.x
124::CODE;;self.y -= val.y
125::CODE;;return self
126::CODE;;def __mul__(self, val):
127::CODE;;try:
128::CODE;;return Vector(list(map(lambda x, y: x * y, self, val)))
129::CODE;;except Exception:
130::CODE;;return Vector([x * val for x in self])
131::CODE;;def __imul__(self, val):
132::CODE;;if type(val) in (int, float):
133::CODE;;self.x *= val
134::CODE;;self.y *= val
135::CODE;;else:
136::CODE;;self.x *= val.x
137::CODE;;self.y *= val.y
138::CODE;;return self
139::CODE;;def __rmul__(self, val):
140::CODE;;return (self * val)
141::CODE;;def __truediv__(self, val):
142::CODE;;try:
143::CODE;;return Vector(list(map(lambda x, y: x / y, self, val)))
144::CODE;;except Exception:
145::CODE;;return Vector([x / val for x in self])
146::CODE;;def __div__(self, val):
147::CODE;;try:
148::CODE;;return Vector(list(map(lambda x, y: x / y, self, val)))
149::CODE;;except Exception:
150::CODE;;return Vector([x / val for x in self])
151::CODE;;def __rtruediv__(self, val):
152::CODE;;try:
153::CODE;;return Vector(*val) / self
154::CODE;;except Exception:
155::CODE;;return Vector(val, val) / self
156::CODE;;def __rdiv__(self, val):
157::CODE;;try:
158::CODE;;return Vector(*val) / self
159::CODE;;except Exception:
160::CODE;;return Vector(val, val) / self
161::CODE;;def __idiv__(self, val):
162::CODE;;if type(val) in (int, float):
163::CODE;;self.x /= val
164::CODE;;self.y /= val
165::CODE;;else:
166::CODE;;self.x /= val.x
167::CODE;;self.y /= val.y
168::CODE;;return self
169::CODE;;def length(self):
170::CODE;;'''Returns the length of a vector.
171::CODE;;>>> Vector(10, 10).length()
172::CODE;;14.142135623730951
173::CODE;;>>> pos = (10, 10)
174::CODE;;>>> Vector(pos).length()
175::CODE;;14.142135623730951
176::CODE;;'''
177::CODE;;return math.sqrt(self[0] ** 2 + self[1] ** 2)
178::CODE;;def length2(self):
179::CODE;;'''Returns the length of a vector squared.
180::CODE;;>>> Vector(10, 10).length2()
181::CODE;;200
182::CODE;;>>> pos = (10, 10)
183::CODE;;>>> Vector(pos).length2()
184::CODE;;200
185::CODE;;'''
186::CODE;;return self[0] ** 2 + self[1] ** 2
187::CODE;;def distance(self, to):
188::CODE;;'''Returns the distance between two points.
189::CODE;;>>> Vector(10, 10).distance((5, 10))
190::CODE;;5.
191::CODE;;>>> a = (90, 33)
192::CODE;;>>> b = (76, 34)
193::CODE;;>>> Vector(a).distance(b)
194::CODE;;14.035668847618199
195::CODE;;'''
196::CODE;;return math.sqrt((self[0] - to[0]) ** 2 + (self[1] - to[1]) ** 2)
197::CODE;;def distance2(self, to):
198::CODE;;'''Returns the distance between two points squared.
199::CODE;;>>> Vector(10, 10).distance2((5, 10))
200::CODE;;25
201::CODE;;'''
202::CODE;;return (self[0] - to[0]) ** 2 + (self[1] - to[1]) ** 2
203::CODE;;def normalize(self):
204::CODE;;'''Returns a new vector that has the same direction as vec,
205::CODE;;but has a length of one.
206::CODE;;>>> v = Vector(88, 33).normalize()
207::CODE;;>>> v
208::CODE;;[0.93632917756904444, 0.3511234415883917]
209::CODE;;>>> v.length()
210::CODE;;1.0
211::CODE;;'''
212::CODE;;if self[0] == 0. and self[1] == 0.:
213::CODE;;return Vector(0., 0.)
214::CODE;;return self / self.length()
215::CODE;;def dot(self, a):
216::CODE;;'''Computes the dot product of a and b.
217::CODE;;>>> Vector(2, 4).dot((2, 2))
218::CODE;;12
219::CODE;;'''
220::CODE;;return self[0] * a[0] + self[1] * a[1]
221::CODE;;def angle(self, a):
222::CODE;;'''Computes the angle between a and b, and returns the angle in
223::CODE;;degrees.
224::CODE;;>>> Vector(100, 0).angle((0, 100))
225::CODE;;-90.0
226::CODE;;>>> Vector(87, 23).angle((-77, 10))
227::CODE;;-157.7920283010705
228::CODE;;'''
229::CODE;;angle = -(180 / math.pi) * math.atan2(
230::CODE;;self[0] * a[1] - self[1] * a[0],
231::CODE;;self[0] * a[0] + self[1] * a[1])
232::CODE;;return angle
233::CODE;;def rotate(self, angle):
234::CODE;;'''Rotate the vector with an angle in degrees.
235::CODE;;>>> v = Vector(100, 0)
236::CODE;;>>> v.rotate(45)
237::CODE;;[70.71067811865476, 70.71067811865474]
238::CODE;;'''
239::CODE;;angle = math.radians(angle)
240::CODE;;return Vector(
241::CODE;;(self[0] * math.cos(angle)) - (self[1] * math.sin(angle)),
242::CODE;;(self[1] * math.cos(angle)) + (self[0] * math.sin(angle)))
243::CODE;;@staticmethod
244::CODE;;def line_intersection(v1, v2, v3, v4):
245::CODE;;'''
246::CODE;;Finds the intersection point between the lines (1)v1->v2 and (2)v3->v4
247::CODE;;and returns it as a vector object.
248::CODE;;>>> a = (98, 28)
249::CODE;;>>> b = (72, 33)
250::CODE;;>>> c = (10, -5)
251::CODE;;>>> d = (20, 88)
252::CODE;;>>> Vector.line_intersection(a, b, c, d)
253::CODE;;[15.25931928687196, 43.911669367909241]
254::CODE;;.. warning::
255::CODE;;This is a line intersection method, not a segment intersection.
256::CODE;;For math see: http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Line-line_intersection
257::CODE;;'''
259::CODE;;x1, x2, x3, x4 = float(v1[0]), float(v2[0]), float(v3[0]), float(v4[0])
260::CODE;;y1, y2, y3, y4 = float(v1[1]), float(v2[1]), float(v3[1]), float(v4[1])
261::CODE;;u = (x1 * y2 - y1 * x2)
262::CODE;;v = (x3 * y4 - y3 * x4)
263::CODE;;denom = (x1 - x2) * (y3 - y4) - (y1 - y2) * (x3 - x4)
264::CODE;;if denom == 0:
265::CODE;;return None
266::CODE;;px = (u * (x3 - x4) - (x1 - x2) * v) / denom
267::CODE;;py = (u * (y3 - y4) - (y1 - y2) * v) / denom
268::CODE;;return Vector(px, py)
269::CODE;;@staticmethod
270::CODE;;def segment_intersection(v1, v2, v3, v4):
271::CODE;;'''
272::CODE;;Finds the intersection point between segments (1)v1->v2 and (2)v3->v4
273::CODE;;and returns it as a vector object.
274::CODE;;>>> a = (98, 28)
275::CODE;;>>> b = (72, 33)
276::CODE;;>>> c = (10, -5)
277::CODE;;>>> d = (20, 88)
278::CODE;;>>> Vector.segment_intersection(a, b, c, d)
279::CODE;;None
280::CODE;;>>> a = (0, 0)
281::CODE;;>>> b = (10, 10)
282::CODE;;>>> c = (0, 10)
283::CODE;;>>> d = (10, 0)
284::CODE;;>>> Vector.segment_intersection(a, b, c, d)
285::CODE;;[5, 5]
286::CODE;;'''
288::CODE;;x1, x2, x3, x4 = float(v1[0]), float(v2[0]), float(v3[0]), float(v4[0])
289::CODE;;y1, y2, y3, y4 = float(v1[1]), float(v2[1]), float(v3[1]), float(v4[1])
291::CODE;;u = (x1 * y2 - y1 * x2)
292::CODE;;v = (x3 * y4 - y3 * x4)
293::CODE;;denom = (x1 - x2) * (y3 - y4) - (y1 - y2) * (x3 - x4)
294::CODE;;if denom == 0:
295::CODE;;return None
296::CODE;;px = (u * (x3 - x4) - (x1 - x2) * v) / denom
297::CODE;;py = (u * (y3 - y4) - (y1 - y2) * v) / denom
299::CODE;;c1 = (x1 <= px <= x2) or (x2 <= px <= x1) or (x1 == x2)
300::CODE;;c2 = (y1 <= py <= y2) or (y2 <= py <= y1) or (y1 == y2)
301::CODE;;c3 = (x3 <= px <= x4) or (x4 <= px <= x3) or (x3 == x4)
302::CODE;;c4 = (y3 <= py <= y4) or (y4 <= py <= y3) or (y3 == y4)
303::CODE;;if (c1 and c2) and (c3 and c4):
304::CODE;;return Vector(px, py)
305::CODE;;else:
306::CODE;;return None
307::CODE;;@staticmethod
308::CODE;;def in_bbox(point, a, b):
309::CODE;;'''Return True if `point` is in the bounding box defined by `a`
310::CODE;;and `b`.
311::CODE;;>>> bmin = (0, 0)
312::CODE;;>>> bmax = (100, 100)
313::CODE;;>>> Vector.in_bbox((50, 50), bmin, bmax)
314::CODE;;True
315::CODE;;>>> Vector.in_bbox((647, -10), bmin, bmax)
316::CODE;;False
317::CODE;;'''
318::CODE;;return ((point[0] <= a[0] and point[0] >= b[0] or
319::CODE;;point[0] <= b[0] and point[0] >= a[0]) and
320::CODE;;(point[1] <= a[1] and point[1] >= b[1] or
321::CODE;;point[1] <= b[1] and point[1] >= a[1]))
12::CODE;;import weakref
13::CODE;;class WeakMethod:
14::CODE;;'''Implementation of a
15::CODE;;`weakref <http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Weak_reference>`_
16::CODE;;for functions and bound methods.
17::CODE;;'''
18::CODE;;def __init__(self, method):
19::CODE;;self.method = None
20::CODE;;self.method_name = None
21::CODE;;try:
22::CODE;;if method.__self__ is not None:
23::CODE;;self.method_name = method.__func__.__name__
24::CODE;;self.proxy = weakref.proxy(method.__self__)
25::CODE;;else:
26::CODE;;self.method = method
27::CODE;;self.proxy = None
28::CODE;;except AttributeError:
29::CODE;;self.method = method
30::CODE;;self.proxy = None
31::CODE;;def __call__(self):
32::CODE;;'''Return a new bound-method like the original, or the
33::CODE;;original function if it was just a function or unbound
34::CODE;;method.
35::CODE;;Returns None if the original object doesn't exist.
36::CODE;;'''
37::CODE;;if self.proxy is not None:
38::CODE;;try:
39::CODE;;return getattr(self.proxy, self.method_name)
40::CODE;;except ReferenceError:
41::CODE;;return None
42::CODE;;return self.method
43::CODE;;def is_dead(self):
44::CODE;;'''Returns True if the referenced callable was a bound method and
45::CODE;;the instance no longer exists. Otherwise, return False.
46::CODE;;'''
47::CODE;;if self.proxy is None:
48::CODE;;return False
49::CODE;;try:
50::CODE;;getattr(self.proxy, self.method_name)
51::CODE;;return False
52::CODE;;except ReferenceError:
53::CODE;;return True
54::CODE;;def __eq__(self, other):
55::CODE;;if type(self) is not type(other):
56::CODE;;return False
57::CODE;;s = self()
58::CODE;;return s is not None and s == other()
59::CODE;;def __repr__(self):
60::CODE;;return '<WeakMethod proxy={} method={} method_name={}>'.format(
61::CODE;;self.proxy, self.method, self.method_name)

4::CODE;;`refs` is several references that can be used in the :ref:`...` directive.
17::CODE;;`module_name` is e.g. `sklearn.feature_extraction`, and `submodule_name` is e.g.
18::CODE;;`image`, so we get the docstring and hook for `sklearn.feature_extraction.image`
19::CODE;;submodule. `module_name` is used to reset the current module because autosummary
20::CODE;;automatically changes the current module.
28::CODE;;CONFIGURING API_REFERENCE
29::CODE;;=========================
30::CODE;;API_REFERENCE maps each module name to a dictionary that consists of the following
31::CODE;;components:
32::CODE;;short_summary (required)
33::CODE;;The text to be printed on the index page; it has nothing to do the API reference
34::CODE;;page of each module.
35::CODE;;description (required, `None` if not needed)
36::CODE;;The additional description for the module to be placed under the module
37::CODE;;docstring, before the sections start.
38::CODE;;sections (required)
39::CODE;;A list of sections, each of which consists of:
40::CODE;;- title (required, `None` if not needed): the section title, commonly it should
41::CODE;;not be `None` except for the first section of a module,
42::CODE;;- description (optional): the optional additional description for the section,
43::CODE;;- autosummary (required): an autosummary block, assuming current module is the
44::CODE;;current module name.
45::CODE;;Essentially, the rendered page would look like the following:
46::CODE;;|---------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
47::CODE;;| {{ module_name }} |
48::CODE;;| ================= |
49::CODE;;| {{ module_docstring }} |
50::CODE;;| {{ description }} |
51::CODE;;| |
52::CODE;;| {{ section_title_1 }} <-------------- Optional if one wants the first |
53::CODE;;| --------------------- section to directly follow |
54::CODE;;| {{ section_description_1 }} without a second-level heading. |
55::CODE;;| {{ section_autosummary_1 }} |
56::CODE;;| |
57::CODE;;| {{ section_title_2 }} |
58::CODE;;| --------------------- |
59::CODE;;| {{ section_description_2 }} |
60::CODE;;| {{ section_autosummary_2 }} |
61::CODE;;| |
62::CODE;;| More sections... |
63::CODE;;|---------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
64::CODE;;Hooks will be automatically generated for each module and each section. For a module,
65::CODE;;e.g., `sklearn.feature_extraction`, the hook would be `feature_extraction_ref`; for a
66::CODE;;section, e.g., "From text" under `sklearn.feature_extraction`, the hook would be
67::CODE;;`feature_extraction_ref-from-text`. However, note that a better way is to refer using
68::CODE;;the :mod: directive, e.g., :mod:`sklearn.feature_extraction` for the module and
69::CODE;;:mod:`sklearn.feature_extraction.text` for the section. Only in case that a section
70::CODE;;is not a particular submodule does the hook become useful, e.g., the "Loaders" section
71::CODE;;under `sklearn.datasets`.
1304::CODE;;CONFIGURING DEPRECATED_API_REFERENCE
1305::CODE;;====================================
1306::CODE;;DEPRECATED_API_REFERENCE maps each deprecation target version to a corresponding
1307::CODE;;autosummary block. It will be placed at the bottom of the API index page under the
1308::CODE;;"Recently deprecated" section. Essentially, the rendered section would look like the
1309::CODE;;following:
1310::CODE;;|------------------------------------------|
1311::CODE;;| To be removed in {{ version_1 }} |
1312::CODE;;| -------------------------------- |
1313::CODE;;| {{ autosummary_1 }} |
1314::CODE;;| |
1315::CODE;;| To be removed in {{ version_2 }} |
1316::CODE;;| -------------------------------- |
1317::CODE;;| {{ autosummary_2 }} |
1318::CODE;;| |
1319::CODE;;| More versions... |
1320::CODE;;|------------------------------------------|
1321::CODE;;Note that the autosummary here assumes that the current module is `sklearn`, i.e., if
1322::CODE;;`sklearn.utils.Memory` is deprecated, one should put `utils.Memory` in the "entries"
1323::CODE;;slot of the autosummary block.
1324::CODE;;Example:
1325::CODE;;DEPRECATED_API_REFERENCE = {
1326::CODE;;"0.24": [
1327::CODE;;"model_selection.fit_grid_point",
1328::CODE;;"utils.safe_indexing",
1329::CODE;;],
1330::CODE;;}

15::CODE;;def _linkcode_resolve(domain, info, package, url_fmt, revision):
27::CODE;;if revision is None:
28::CODE;;return
29::CODE;;if domain not in ("py", "pyx"):
30::CODE;;return
31::CODE;;if not info.get("module") or not info.get("fullname"):
32::CODE;;return
33::CODE;;class_name = info["fullname"].split(".")[0]
34::CODE;;module = __import__(info["module"], fromlist=[class_name])
35::CODE;;obj = attrgetter(info["fullname"])(module)
38::CODE;;obj = inspect.unwrap(obj)
39::CODE;;try:
40::CODE;;fn = inspect.getsourcefile(obj)
41::CODE;;except Exception:
42::CODE;;fn = None
43::CODE;;if not fn:
44::CODE;;try:
45::CODE;;fn = inspect.getsourcefile(sys.modules[obj.__module__])
46::CODE;;except Exception:
47::CODE;;fn = None
48::CODE;;if not fn:
49::CODE;;return
50::CODE;;try:
51::CODE;;fn = os.path.relpath(fn, start=os.path.dirname(__import__(package).__file__))
52::CODE;;except ValueError:
53::CODE;;return None
54::CODE;;try:
55::CODE;;lineno = inspect.getsourcelines(obj)[1]
56::CODE;;except Exception:
57::CODE;;lineno = ""
58::CODE;;return url_fmt.format(revision=revision, package=package, path=fn, lineno=lineno)
59::CODE;;def make_linkcode_resolve(package, url_fmt):
67::CODE;;revision = _get_git_revision()

69::CODE;;_linkcode_resolve, revision=revision, package=package, url_fmt=url_fmt
70::CODE;;)

38::CODE;;from sklearn.linear_model import Lasso, Ridge
39::CODE;;def _weights(x, dx=1, orig=0):
40::CODE;;x = np.ravel(x)
41::CODE;;floor_x = np.floor((x - orig) / dx).astype(np.int64)
42::CODE;;alpha = (x - orig - floor_x * dx) / dx
43::CODE;;return np.hstack((floor_x, floor_x + 1)), np.hstack((1 - alpha, alpha))
44::CODE;;def _generate_center_coordinates(l_x):
45::CODE;;X, Y = np.mgrid[:l_x, :l_x].astype(np.float64)
46::CODE;;center = l_x / 2.0
47::CODE;;X += 0.5 - center
48::CODE;;Y += 0.5 - center
49::CODE;;return X, Y
50::CODE;;def build_projection_operator(l_x, n_dir):
62::CODE;;X, Y = _generate_center_coordinates(l_x)
63::CODE;;angles = np.linspace(0, np.pi, n_dir, endpoint=False)
64::CODE;;data_inds, weights, camera_inds = [], [], []
65::CODE;;data_unravel_indices = np.arange(l_x**2)
66::CODE;;data_unravel_indices = np.hstack((data_unravel_indices, data_unravel_indices))
67::CODE;;for i, angle in enumerate(angles):
68::CODE;;Xrot = np.cos(angle) * X - np.sin(angle) * Y
69::CODE;;inds, w = _weights(Xrot, dx=1, orig=X.min())
70::CODE;;mask = np.logical_and(inds >= 0, inds < l_x)
71::CODE;;weights += list(w[mask])
72::CODE;;camera_inds += list(inds[mask] + i * l_x)
73::CODE;;data_inds += list(data_unravel_indices[mask])
74::CODE;;proj_operator = sparse.coo_matrix((weights, (camera_inds, data_inds)))
75::CODE;;return proj_operator

82::CODE;;def plot_ellipse(mean, cov, color, ax):
83::CODE;;v, w = np.linalg.eigh(cov)
84::CODE;;u = w[0] / np.linalg.norm(w[0])
85::CODE;;angle = np.arctan(u[1] / u[0])
88::CODE;;ell = mpl.patches.Ellipse(
89::CODE;;mean,
90::CODE;;2 * v[0] ** 0.5,
91::CODE;;2 * v[1] ** 0.5,
92::CODE;;angle=180 + angle,
93::CODE;;facecolor=color,
94::CODE;;edgecolor="black",
95::CODE;;linewidth=2,
96::CODE;;)
97::CODE;;ell.set_clip_box(ax.bbox)
98::CODE;;ell.set_alpha(0.4)
99::CODE;;ax.add_artist(ell)

55::CODE;;(a + amplitude_noise) * (sqr(6 * (t + phi + phase_noise)))

58::CODE;;)

15::CODE;;def plot_dendrogram(model, **kwargs):
18::CODE;;counts = np.zeros(model.children_.shape[0])
19::CODE;;n_samples = len(model.labels_)
20::CODE;;for i, merge in enumerate(model.children_):
21::CODE;;current_count = 0
22::CODE;;for child_idx in merge:
23::CODE;;if child_idx < n_samples:
25::CODE;;else:
26::CODE;;current_count += counts[child_idx - n_samples]
27::CODE;;counts[i] = current_count
28::CODE;;linkage_matrix = np.column_stack(
29::CODE;;[model.children_, model.distances_, counts]
30::CODE;;).astype(float)
32::CODE;;dendrogram(linkage_matrix, **kwargs)

49::CODE;;return self

55::CODE;;def decision_function(self, X):
56::CODE;;check_is_fitted(self)
57::CODE;;return self.classifier_.decision_function(X)

56::CODE;;repeat = 10

58::CODE;;(
59::CODE;;np.linspace(0, n_samples / 8, 5),
60::CODE;;np.linspace(n_samples / 8, n_samples / 2, 5)[1:-1],
61::CODE;;)
62::CODE;;).astype(int)
64::CODE;;err_loc_mcd = np.zeros((range_n_outliers.size, repeat))

66::CODE;;err_loc_emp_full = np.zeros((range_n_outliers.size, repeat))
67::CODE;;err_cov_emp_full = np.zeros((range_n_outliers.size, repeat))

69::CODE;;err_cov_emp_pure = np.zeros((range_n_outliers.size, repeat))
71::CODE;;for i, n_outliers in enumerate(range_n_outliers):
72::CODE;;for j in range(repeat):
73::CODE;;rng = np.random.RandomState(i * j)

88::CODE;;err_cov_mcd[i, j] = mcd.error_norm(np.eye(n_features))
91::CODE;;err_loc_emp_full[i, j] = np.sum(X.mean(0) ** 2)
92::CODE;;err_cov_emp_full[i, j] = (
93::CODE;;EmpiricalCovariance().fit(X).error_norm(np.eye(n_features))
94::CODE;;)

99::CODE;;pure_emp_cov = EmpiricalCovariance().fit(pure_X)
100::CODE;;err_loc_emp_pure[i, j] = np.sum(pure_location**2)
101::CODE;;err_cov_emp_pure[i, j] = pure_emp_cov.error_norm(np.eye(n_features))

20::CODE;;def ricker_function(resolution, center, width):
31::CODE;;centers = np.linspace(0, resolution - 1, n_components)
32::CODE;;D = np.empty((n_components, resolution))
33::CODE;;for i, center in enumerate(centers):
34::CODE;;D[i] = ricker_function(resolution, center, width)
35::CODE;;D /= np.sqrt(np.sum(D**2, axis=1))[:, np.newaxis]
36::CODE;;return D
37::CODE;;resolution = 1024
39::CODE;;width = 100
40::CODE;;n_components = resolution // subsampling
42::CODE;;D_fixed = ricker_matrix(width=width, resolution=resolution, n_components=n_components)
43::CODE;;D_multi = np.r_[
44::CODE;;tuple(
45::CODE;;ricker_matrix(width=w, resolution=resolution, n_components=n_components // 5)
46::CODE;;for w in (10, 50, 100, 500, 1000)
47::CODE;;)
48::CODE;;]
50::CODE;;y = np.linspace(0, resolution - 1, resolution)
51::CODE;;first_quarter = y < resolution / 4
52::CODE;;y[first_quarter] = 3.0
53::CODE;;y[np.logical_not(first_quarter)] = -1.0
57::CODE;;estimators = [

71::CODE;;coder = SparseCoder(
72::CODE;;dictionary=D,
73::CODE;;transform_n_nonzero_coefs=n_nonzero,
74::CODE;;transform_alpha=alpha,
75::CODE;;transform_algorithm=algo,
76::CODE;;)
77::CODE;;x = coder.transform(y.reshape(1, -1))
78::CODE;;density = len(np.flatnonzero(x))
79::CODE;;x = np.ravel(np.dot(x, D))
80::CODE;;squared_error = np.sum((y - x) ** 2)
81::CODE;;plt.plot(
82::CODE;;x,
83::CODE;;color=color,
84::CODE;;lw=lw,
85::CODE;;label="%s: %s nonzero coefs,\n%.2f error" % (title, density, squared_error),
86::CODE;;)
88::CODE;;coder = SparseCoder(
89::CODE;;dictionary=D, transform_algorithm="threshold", transform_alpha=20
90::CODE;;)
91::CODE;;x = coder.transform(y.reshape(1, -1))
92::CODE;;_, idx = (x != 0).nonzero()
93::CODE;;x[0, idx], _, _, _ = np.linalg.lstsq(D[idx, :].T, y, rcond=None)
94::CODE;;x = np.ravel(np.dot(x, D))
95::CODE;;squared_error = np.sum((y - x) ** 2)
96::CODE;;plt.plot(
97::CODE;;x,
98::CODE;;color="darkorange",
99::CODE;;lw=lw,

101::CODE;;% (len(idx), squared_error),
102::CODE;;)

58::CODE;;import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
59::CODE;;import numpy as np
60::CODE;;from sklearn.ensemble import BaggingRegressor
61::CODE;;from sklearn.tree import DecisionTreeRegressor
67::CODE;;np.random.seed(0)
72::CODE;;estimators = [
73::CODE;;("Tree", DecisionTreeRegressor()),
74::CODE;;("Bagging(Tree)", BaggingRegressor(DecisionTreeRegressor())),
75::CODE;;]
76::CODE;;n_estimators = len(estimators)
78::CODE;;def f(x):
79::CODE;;x = x.ravel()
80::CODE;;return np.exp(-(x**2)) + 1.5 * np.exp(-((x - 2) ** 2))
81::CODE;;def generate(n_samples, noise, n_repeat=1):
82::CODE;;X = np.random.rand(n_samples) * 10 - 5
83::CODE;;X = np.sort(X)
84::CODE;;if n_repeat == 1:
85::CODE;;y = f(X) + np.random.normal(0.0, noise, n_samples)
86::CODE;;else:
87::CODE;;y = np.zeros((n_samples, n_repeat))
88::CODE;;for i in range(n_repeat):
89::CODE;;y[:, i] = f(X) + np.random.normal(0.0, noise, n_samples)
90::CODE;;X = X.reshape((n_samples, 1))
91::CODE;;return X, y
92::CODE;;X_train = []
93::CODE;;y_train = []
94::CODE;;for i in range(n_repeat):
95::CODE;;X, y = generate(n_samples=n_train, noise=noise)
96::CODE;;X_train.append(X)
97::CODE;;y_train.append(y)
98::CODE;;X_test, y_test = generate(n_samples=n_test, noise=noise, n_repeat=n_repeat)
99::CODE;;plt.figure(figsize=(10, 8))
101::CODE;;for n, (name, estimator) in enumerate(estimators):
103::CODE;;y_predict = np.zeros((n_test, n_repeat))
104::CODE;;for i in range(n_repeat):
105::CODE;;estimator.fit(X_train[i], y_train[i])
106::CODE;;y_predict[:, i] = estimator.predict(X_test)
108::CODE;;y_error = np.zeros(n_test)
109::CODE;;for i in range(n_repeat):
110::CODE;;for j in range(n_repeat):
111::CODE;;y_error += (y_test[:, j] - y_predict[:, i]) ** 2
112::CODE;;y_error /= n_repeat * n_repeat
113::CODE;;y_noise = np.var(y_test, axis=1)
114::CODE;;y_bias = (f(X_test) - np.mean(y_predict, axis=1)) ** 2
115::CODE;;y_var = np.var(y_predict, axis=1)
116::CODE;;print(
117::CODE;;"{0}: {1:.4f} (error) = {2:.4f} (bias^2) "
118::CODE;;" + {3:.4f} (var) + {4:.4f} (noise)".format(
119::CODE;;name, np.mean(y_error), np.mean(y_bias), np.mean(y_var), np.mean(y_noise)
120::CODE;;)
121::CODE;;)
123::CODE;;plt.subplot(2, n_estimators, n + 1)
124::CODE;;plt.plot(X_test, f(X_test), "b", label="$f(x)$")
125::CODE;;plt.plot(X_train[0], y_train[0], ".b", label="LS ~ $y = f(x)+noise$")
126::CODE;;for i in range(n_repeat):
127::CODE;;if i == 0:
128::CODE;;plt.plot(X_test, y_predict[:, i], "r", label=r"$\^y(x)$")
129::CODE;;else:
130::CODE;;plt.plot(X_test, y_predict[:, i], "r", alpha=0.05)
131::CODE;;plt.plot(X_test, np.mean(y_predict, axis=1), "c", label=r"$\mathbb{E}_{LS} \^y(x)$")
132::CODE;;plt.xlim([-5, 5])
133::CODE;;plt.title(name)
134::CODE;;if n == n_estimators - 1:
135::CODE;;plt.legend(loc=(1.1, 0.5))
136::CODE;;plt.subplot(2, n_estimators, n_estimators + n + 1)
137::CODE;;plt.plot(X_test, y_error, "r", label="$error(x)$")
138::CODE;;plt.plot(X_test, y_bias, "b", label="$bias^2(x)$")
139::CODE;;plt.plot(X_test, y_var, "g", label="$variance(x)$")

34::CODE;;import numpy as np
35::CODE;;from sklearn.base import clone
36::CODE;;from sklearn.gaussian_process import GaussianProcessClassifier, GaussianProcessRegressor
37::CODE;;from sklearn.gaussian_process.kernels import GenericKernelMixin, Hyperparameter, Kernel
38::CODE;;class SequenceKernel(GenericKernelMixin, Kernel):
42::CODE;;def __init__(self, baseline_similarity=0.5, baseline_similarity_bounds=(1e-5, 1)):
43::CODE;;self.baseline_similarity = baseline_similarity
44::CODE;;self.baseline_similarity_bounds = baseline_similarity_bounds
45::CODE;;@property
46::CODE;;def hyperparameter_baseline_similarity(self):
47::CODE;;return Hyperparameter(
48::CODE;;"baseline_similarity", "numeric", self.baseline_similarity_bounds
49::CODE;;)
50::CODE;;def _f(self, s1, s2):
54::CODE;;return sum(
55::CODE;;[1.0 if c1 == c2 else self.baseline_similarity for c1 in s1 for c2 in s2]
56::CODE;;)
57::CODE;;def _g(self, s1, s2):
61::CODE;;return sum([0.0 if c1 == c2 else 1.0 for c1 in s1 for c2 in s2])
62::CODE;;def __call__(self, X, Y=None, eval_gradient=False):
63::CODE;;if Y is None:
64::CODE;;Y = X
65::CODE;;if eval_gradient:
66::CODE;;return (
67::CODE;;np.array([[self._f(x, y) for y in Y] for x in X]),
68::CODE;;np.array([[[self._g(x, y)] for y in Y] for x in X]),
69::CODE;;)
70::CODE;;else:
71::CODE;;return np.array([[self._f(x, y) for y in Y] for x in X])
72::CODE;;def diag(self, X):
73::CODE;;return np.array([self._f(x, x) for x in X])
74::CODE;;def is_stationary(self):
75::CODE;;return False
76::CODE;;def clone_with_theta(self, theta):
77::CODE;;cloned = clone(self)
78::CODE;;cloned.theta = theta
79::CODE;;return cloned
80::CODE;;kernel = SequenceKernel()
84::CODE;;import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
85::CODE;;X = np.array(["AGCT", "AGC", "AACT", "TAA", "AAA", "GAACA"])
86::CODE;;K = kernel(X)
87::CODE;;D = kernel.diag(X)
88::CODE;;plt.figure(figsize=(8, 5))
89::CODE;;plt.imshow(np.diag(D**-0.5).dot(K).dot(np.diag(D**-0.5)))
90::CODE;;plt.xticks(np.arange(len(X)), X)
91::CODE;;plt.yticks(np.arange(len(X)), X)
92::CODE;;plt.title("Sequence similarity under the kernel")
93::CODE;;plt.show()

48::CODE;;from sklearn.model_selection import cross_val_score

52::CODE;;N_SPLITS = 5
53::CODE;;X_full, y_full = fetch_california_housing(return_X_y=True)
56::CODE;;X_full = X_full[::10]
57::CODE;;y_full = y_full[::10]
58::CODE;;n_samples, n_features = X_full.shape
59::CODE;;def compute_score_for(X, y, imputer=None):
63::CODE;;if imputer is None:
64::CODE;;estimator = make_pipeline(RobustScaler(), BayesianRidge())
65::CODE;;else:
66::CODE;;estimator = make_pipeline(RobustScaler(), imputer, BayesianRidge())
67::CODE;;return cross_val_score(
68::CODE;;estimator, X, y, scoring="neg_mean_squared_error", cv=N_SPLITS
69::CODE;;)
71::CODE;;score_full_data = pd.DataFrame(
72::CODE;;compute_score_for(X_full, y_full),
73::CODE;;columns=["Full Data"],
74::CODE;;)
76::CODE;;rng = np.random.RandomState(0)
77::CODE;;X_missing = X_full.copy()
78::CODE;;y_missing = y_full
79::CODE;;missing_samples = np.arange(n_samples)
80::CODE;;missing_features = rng.choice(n_features, n_samples, replace=True)
81::CODE;;X_missing[missing_samples, missing_features] = np.nan
83::CODE;;score_simple_imputer = pd.DataFrame()
84::CODE;;for strategy in ("mean", "median"):
85::CODE;;score_simple_imputer[strategy] = compute_score_for(
86::CODE;;X_missing, y_missing, SimpleImputer(strategy=strategy)
87::CODE;;)
90::CODE;;named_estimators = [
91::CODE;;("Bayesian Ridge", BayesianRidge()),
92::CODE;;(
93::CODE;;"Random Forest",
94::CODE;;RandomForestRegressor(
97::CODE;;n_estimators=5,
98::CODE;;max_depth=10,
99::CODE;;bootstrap=True,
100::CODE;;max_samples=0.5,
101::CODE;;n_jobs=2,
102::CODE;;random_state=0,
103::CODE;;),
104::CODE;;),
105::CODE;;(
106::CODE;;"Nystroem + Ridge",
107::CODE;;make_pipeline(
108::CODE;;Nystroem(kernel="polynomial", degree=2, random_state=0), Ridge(alpha=1e4)
109::CODE;;),
110::CODE;;),
111::CODE;;(
112::CODE;;"k-NN",
113::CODE;;KNeighborsRegressor(n_neighbors=10),
114::CODE;;),
115::CODE;;]

123::CODE;;for (name, impute_estimator), tol in zip(named_estimators, tolerances):
124::CODE;;score_iterative_imputer[name] = compute_score_for(
125::CODE;;X_missing,
126::CODE;;y_missing,
127::CODE;;IterativeImputer(
128::CODE;;random_state=0, estimator=impute_estimator, max_iter=40, tol=tol
129::CODE;;),
130::CODE;;)

111::CODE;;from scipy.cluster import hierarchy
112::CODE;;from scipy.spatial.distance import squareform
113::CODE;;from scipy.stats import spearmanr
114::CODE;;fig, (ax1, ax2) = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(12, 8))
115::CODE;;corr = spearmanr(X).correlation
117::CODE;;corr = (corr + corr.T) / 2
118::CODE;;np.fill_diagonal(corr, 1)
121::CODE;;distance_matrix = 1 - np.abs(corr)
122::CODE;;dist_linkage = hierarchy.ward(squareform(distance_matrix))
123::CODE;;dendro = hierarchy.dendrogram(
124::CODE;;dist_linkage, labels=X.columns.to_list(), ax=ax1, leaf_rotation=90
125::CODE;;)
126::CODE;;dendro_idx = np.arange(0, len(dendro["ivl"]))
127::CODE;;ax2.imshow(corr[dendro["leaves"], :][:, dendro["leaves"]])

129::CODE;;ax2.set_yticks(dendro_idx)
130::CODE;;ax2.set_xticklabels(dendro["ivl"], rotation="vertical")
131::CODE;;ax2.set_yticklabels(dendro["ivl"])
132::CODE;;_ = fig.tight_layout()

95::CODE;;def plot_hyperplanes(classifier, X, ax):
96::CODE;;xmin, xmax = X[:, 0].min(), X[:, 0].max()
97::CODE;;ymin, ymax = X[:, 1].min(), X[:, 1].max()
98::CODE;;ax.set(xlim=(xmin, xmax), ylim=(ymin, ymax))
99::CODE;;if isinstance(classifier, OneVsRestClassifier):
100::CODE;;coef = np.concatenate([est.coef_ for est in classifier.estimators_])
101::CODE;;intercept = np.concatenate([est.intercept_ for est in classifier.estimators_])
102::CODE;;else:
103::CODE;;coef = classifier.coef_
104::CODE;;intercept = classifier.intercept_
105::CODE;;for i in range(coef.shape[0]):
106::CODE;;w = coef[i]
107::CODE;;a = -w[0] / w[1]
108::CODE;;xx = np.linspace(xmin, xmax)
109::CODE;;yy = a * xx - (intercept[i]) / w[1]
110::CODE;;ax.plot(xx, yy, "--", linewidth=3, label=f"Class {i}")
111::CODE;;return ax.get_legend_handles_labels()
113::CODE;;fig, (ax1, ax2) = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(12, 5), sharex=True, sharey=True)
114::CODE;;for model, title, ax in [
115::CODE;;(
116::CODE;;logistic_regression_multinomial,
117::CODE;;"Multinomial Logistic Regression Hyperplanes",
118::CODE;;ax1,
119::CODE;;),
120::CODE;;(logistic_regression_ovr, "One-vs-Rest Logistic Regression Hyperplanes", ax2),
121::CODE;;]:
122::CODE;;hyperplane_handles, hyperplane_labels = plot_hyperplanes(model, X, ax)
123::CODE;;scatter = ax.scatter(X[:, 0], X[:, 1], c=y, edgecolor="k")
124::CODE;;scatter_handles, scatter_labels = scatter.legend_elements()
125::CODE;;all_handles = hyperplane_handles + scatter_handles
126::CODE;;all_labels = hyperplane_labels + scatter_labels
127::CODE;;ax.legend(all_handles, all_labels, title="Classes")

10::CODE;;import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
11::CODE;;import numpy as np
12::CODE;;def modified_huber_loss(y_true, y_pred):
13::CODE;;z = y_pred * y_true
14::CODE;;loss = -4 * z
15::CODE;;loss[z >= -1] = (1 - z[z >= -1]) ** 2
16::CODE;;loss[z >= 1.0] = 0
17::CODE;;return loss
18::CODE;;xmin, xmax = -4, 4
19::CODE;;xx = np.linspace(xmin, xmax, 100)
20::CODE;;lw = 2
21::CODE;;plt.plot([xmin, 0, 0, xmax], [1, 1, 0, 0], color="gold", lw=lw, label="Zero-one loss")
22::CODE;;plt.plot(xx, np.where(xx < 1, 1 - xx, 0), color="teal", lw=lw, label="Hinge loss")
23::CODE;;plt.plot(xx, -np.minimum(xx, 0), color="yellowgreen", lw=lw, label="Perceptron loss")
24::CODE;;plt.plot(xx, np.log2(1 + np.exp(-xx)), color="cornflowerblue", lw=lw, label="Log loss")

23::CODE;;import numpy as np
24::CODE;;from sklearn.datasets import fetch_20newsgroups_vectorized
25::CODE;;from sklearn.exceptions import ConvergenceWarning
26::CODE;;from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
27::CODE;;from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
28::CODE;;from sklearn.multiclass import OneVsRestClassifier
29::CODE;;warnings.filterwarnings("ignore", category=ConvergenceWarning, module="sklearn")
30::CODE;;t0 = timeit.default_timer()
32::CODE;;solver = "saga"
34::CODE;;n_samples = 5000
35::CODE;;X, y = fetch_20newsgroups_vectorized(subset="all", return_X_y=True)
36::CODE;;X = X[:n_samples]
37::CODE;;y = y[:n_samples]
38::CODE;;X_train, X_test, y_train, y_test = train_test_split(
39::CODE;;X, y, random_state=42, stratify=y, test_size=0.1
40::CODE;;)
41::CODE;;train_samples, n_features = X_train.shape
42::CODE;;n_classes = np.unique(y).shape[0]
43::CODE;;print(
44::CODE;;"Dataset 20newsgroup, train_samples=%i, n_features=%i, n_classes=%i"
45::CODE;;% (train_samples, n_features, n_classes)
46::CODE;;)
47::CODE;;models = {
48::CODE;;"ovr": {"name": "One versus Rest", "iters": [1, 2, 3]},
49::CODE;;"multinomial": {"name": "Multinomial", "iters": [1, 2, 5]},
50::CODE;;}
51::CODE;;for model in models:
53::CODE;;accuracies = [1 / n_classes]
54::CODE;;times = [0]
55::CODE;;densities = [1]
56::CODE;;model_params = models[model]
58::CODE;;for this_max_iter in model_params["iters"]:
59::CODE;;print(
60::CODE;;"[model=%s, solver=%s] Number of epochs: %s"
61::CODE;;% (model_params["name"], solver, this_max_iter)
62::CODE;;)
63::CODE;;clf = LogisticRegression(
64::CODE;;solver=solver,
65::CODE;;penalty="l1",
66::CODE;;max_iter=this_max_iter,
67::CODE;;random_state=42,
68::CODE;;)
69::CODE;;if model == "ovr":
70::CODE;;clf = OneVsRestClassifier(clf)
71::CODE;;t1 = timeit.default_timer()
72::CODE;;clf.fit(X_train, y_train)
73::CODE;;train_time = timeit.default_timer() - t1
74::CODE;;y_pred = clf.predict(X_test)
75::CODE;;accuracy = np.sum(y_pred == y_test) / y_test.shape[0]
76::CODE;;if model == "ovr":
77::CODE;;coef = np.concatenate([est.coef_ for est in clf.estimators_])
78::CODE;;else:
79::CODE;;coef = clf.coef_
80::CODE;;density = np.mean(coef != 0, axis=1) * 100
81::CODE;;accuracies.append(accuracy)
82::CODE;;densities.append(density)
83::CODE;;times.append(train_time)
84::CODE;;models[model]["times"] = times
85::CODE;;models[model]["densities"] = densities
86::CODE;;models[model]["accuracies"] = accuracies
87::CODE;;print("Test accuracy for model %s: %.4f" % (model, accuracies[-1]))
88::CODE;;print(
89::CODE;;"%% non-zero coefficients for model %s, per class:\n %s"
90::CODE;;% (model, densities[-1])
91::CODE;;)
92::CODE;;print(
93::CODE;;"Run time (%i epochs) for model %s:%.2f"
94::CODE;;% (model_params["iters"][-1], model, times[-1])
95::CODE;;)
96::CODE;;fig = plt.figure()
97::CODE;;ax = fig.add_subplot(111)
98::CODE;;for model in models:
99::CODE;;name = models[model]["name"]
100::CODE;;times = models[model]["times"]
101::CODE;;accuracies = models[model]["accuracies"]
102::CODE;;ax.plot(times, accuracies, marker="o", label="Model: %s" % name)
103::CODE;;ax.set_xlabel("Train time (s)")
104::CODE;;ax.set_ylabel("Test accuracy")

33::CODE;;def plot_ellipses(ax, weights, means, covars):
34::CODE;;for n in range(means.shape[0]):
35::CODE;;eig_vals, eig_vecs = np.linalg.eigh(covars[n])
36::CODE;;unit_eig_vec = eig_vecs[0] / np.linalg.norm(eig_vecs[0])
37::CODE;;angle = np.arctan2(unit_eig_vec[1], unit_eig_vec[0])
39::CODE;;angle = 180 * angle / np.pi
41::CODE;;eig_vals = 2 * np.sqrt(2) * np.sqrt(eig_vals)
42::CODE;;ell = mpl.patches.Ellipse(
43::CODE;;means[n], eig_vals[0], eig_vals[1], angle=180 + angle, edgecolor="black"
44::CODE;;)
45::CODE;;ell.set_clip_box(ax.bbox)
46::CODE;;ell.set_alpha(weights[n])
48::CODE;;ax.add_artist(ell)

33::CODE;;for n, color in enumerate(colors):

89::CODE;;def fpr_score(y, y_pred, neg_label, pos_label):

453::CODE;;def business_metric(y_true, y_pred, amount):
454::CODE;;mask_true_positive = (y_true == 1) & (y_pred == 1)
455::CODE;;mask_true_negative = (y_true == 0) & (y_pred == 0)
456::CODE;;mask_false_positive = (y_true == 0) & (y_pred == 1)
457::CODE;;mask_false_negative = (y_true == 1) & (y_pred == 0)
458::CODE;;fraudulent_refuse = mask_true_positive.sum() * 50
459::CODE;;fraudulent_accept = -amount[mask_false_negative].sum()
460::CODE;;legitimate_refuse = mask_false_positive.sum() * -5
461::CODE;;legitimate_accept = (amount[mask_true_negative] * 0.02).sum()
462::CODE;;return fraudulent_refuse + fraudulent_accept + legitimate_refuse + legitimate_accept
469::CODE;;sklearn.set_config(enable_metadata_routing=True)
470::CODE;;business_scorer = make_scorer(business_metric).set_score_request(amount=True)

485::CODE;;)
486::CODE;;)

491::CODE;;always_accept_policy = DummyClassifier(strategy="constant", constant=0)
492::CODE;;always_accept_policy.fit(data_train, target_train)
493::CODE;;benefit = business_scorer(
494::CODE;;always_accept_policy, data_test, target_test, amount=amount_test
495::CODE;;)
496::CODE;;print(f"Benefit of the 'always accept' policy: {benefit:,.2f}€")
501::CODE;;always_reject_policy = DummyClassifier(strategy="constant", constant=1)
502::CODE;;always_reject_policy.fit(data_train, target_train)

504::CODE;;always_reject_policy, data_test, target_test, amount=amount_test

146::CODE;;def corrected_std(differences, n_train, n_test):
163::CODE;;kr = len(differences)
164::CODE;;corrected_var = np.var(differences, ddof=1) * (1 / kr + n_test / n_train)
165::CODE;;corrected_std = np.sqrt(corrected_var)
166::CODE;;return corrected_std
167::CODE;;def compute_corrected_ttest(differences, df, n_train, n_test):
186::CODE;;mean = np.mean(differences)
187::CODE;;std = corrected_std(differences, n_train, n_test)
188::CODE;;t_stat = mean / std
190::CODE;;return t_stat, p_val

188::CODE;;def scoring_on_bootstrap(estimator, X, y, rng, n_bootstrap=100):
189::CODE;;results_for_prevalence = defaultdict(list)
190::CODE;;for _ in range(n_bootstrap):
191::CODE;;bootstrap_indices = rng.choice(
192::CODE;;np.arange(X.shape[0]), size=X.shape[0], replace=True
193::CODE;;)
194::CODE;;for key, value in scoring(
195::CODE;;estimator, X[bootstrap_indices], y[bootstrap_indices]
196::CODE;;).items():
197::CODE;;results_for_prevalence[key].append(value)
198::CODE;;return pd.DataFrame(results_for_prevalence)
201::CODE;;results = defaultdict(list)
202::CODE;;n_bootstrap = 100
203::CODE;;rng = np.random.default_rng(seed=0)
204::CODE;;for prevalence, X, y in zip(
205::CODE;;populations["prevalence"], populations["X"], populations["y"]
206::CODE;;):
207::CODE;;results_for_prevalence = scoring_on_bootstrap(
208::CODE;;estimator, X, y, rng, n_bootstrap=n_bootstrap
209::CODE;;)
210::CODE;;results["prevalence"].append(prevalence)
211::CODE;;results["metrics"].append(
212::CODE;;results_for_prevalence.aggregate(["mean", "std"]).unstack()
213::CODE;;)
214::CODE;;results = pd.DataFrame(results["metrics"], index=results["prevalence"])
215::CODE;;results.index.name = "prevalence"

41::CODE;;ax.axes.get_xaxis().set_visible(False)
42::CODE;;ax.axes.get_yaxis().set_visible(False)
44::CODE;;def link_thickness_i(X, i):
45::CODE;;diff_embedded = X[i] - X
46::CODE;;dist_embedded = np.einsum("ij,ij->i", diff_embedded, diff_embedded)
47::CODE;;dist_embedded[i] = np.inf
50::CODE;;exp_dist_embedded = np.exp(-dist_embedded - logsumexp(-dist_embedded))
51::CODE;;return exp_dist_embedded
52::CODE;;def relate_point(X, i, ax):
53::CODE;;pt_i = X[i]
54::CODE;;for j, pt_j in enumerate(X):
55::CODE;;thickness = link_thickness_i(X, i)
56::CODE;;if i != j:
57::CODE;;line = ([pt_i[0], pt_j[0]], [pt_i[1], pt_j[1]])
58::CODE;;ax.plot(*line, c=cm.Set1(y[j]), linewidth=5 * thickness[j])
59::CODE;;i = 3
60::CODE;;relate_point(X, i, ax)
61::CODE;;plt.show()
68::CODE;;nca = NeighborhoodComponentsAnalysis(max_iter=30, random_state=0)
69::CODE;;nca = nca.fit(X, y)
70::CODE;;plt.figure(2)
71::CODE;;ax2 = plt.gca()
72::CODE;;X_embedded = nca.transform(X)
73::CODE;;relate_point(X_embedded, i, ax2)
74::CODE;;for i in range(len(X)):
75::CODE;;ax2.text(X_embedded[i, 0], X_embedded[i, 1], str(i), va="center", ha="center")
76::CODE;;ax2.scatter(X_embedded[i, 0], X_embedded[i, 1], s=300, c=cm.Set1(y[[i]]), alpha=0.4)
77::CODE;;ax2.set_title("NCA embedding")

20::CODE;;import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
21::CODE;;import numpy as np
22::CODE;;from scipy import stats
23::CODE;;from sklearn import datasets
24::CODE;;from sklearn.metrics import classification_report, confusion_matrix
25::CODE;;from sklearn.semi_supervised import LabelSpreading
26::CODE;;digits = datasets.load_digits()
27::CODE;;rng = np.random.RandomState(0)
28::CODE;;indices = np.arange(len(digits.data))
29::CODE;;rng.shuffle(indices)
30::CODE;;X = digits.data[indices[:330]]
31::CODE;;y = digits.target[indices[:330]]
32::CODE;;images = digits.images[indices[:330]]
33::CODE;;n_total_samples = len(y)
34::CODE;;n_labeled_points = 40
35::CODE;;max_iterations = 5
36::CODE;;unlabeled_indices = np.arange(n_total_samples)[n_labeled_points:]
37::CODE;;f = plt.figure()
38::CODE;;for i in range(max_iterations):
39::CODE;;if len(unlabeled_indices) == 0:
40::CODE;;print("No unlabeled items left to label.")
41::CODE;;break
42::CODE;;y_train = np.copy(y)
43::CODE;;y_train[unlabeled_indices] = -1
44::CODE;;lp_model = LabelSpreading(gamma=0.25, max_iter=20)
45::CODE;;lp_model.fit(X, y_train)
46::CODE;;predicted_labels = lp_model.transduction_[unlabeled_indices]
47::CODE;;true_labels = y[unlabeled_indices]
48::CODE;;cm = confusion_matrix(true_labels, predicted_labels, labels=lp_model.classes_)
49::CODE;;print("Iteration %i %s" % (i, 70 * "_"))
50::CODE;;print(
51::CODE;;"Label Spreading model: %d labeled & %d unlabeled (%d total)"
52::CODE;;% (n_labeled_points, n_total_samples - n_labeled_points, n_total_samples)
53::CODE;;)
54::CODE;;print(classification_report(true_labels, predicted_labels))
55::CODE;;print("Confusion matrix")
56::CODE;;print(cm)
58::CODE;;pred_entropies = stats.distributions.entropy(lp_model.label_distributions_.T)
60::CODE;;uncertainty_index = np.argsort(pred_entropies)[::-1]
61::CODE;;uncertainty_index = uncertainty_index[
62::CODE;;np.isin(uncertainty_index, unlabeled_indices)
63::CODE;;][:5]
65::CODE;;delete_indices = np.array([], dtype=int)
67::CODE;;if i < 5:
68::CODE;;f.text(
69::CODE;;0.05,
70::CODE;;(1 - (i + 1) * 0.183),
71::CODE;;"model %d\n\nfit with\n%d labels" % ((i + 1), i * 5 + 10),
72::CODE;;size=10,
73::CODE;;)
74::CODE;;for index, image_index in enumerate(uncertainty_index):
75::CODE;;image = images[image_index]
77::CODE;;if i < 5:
78::CODE;;sub = f.add_subplot(5, 5, index + 1 + (5 * i))
79::CODE;;sub.imshow(image, cmap=plt.cm.gray_r, interpolation="none")
80::CODE;;sub.set_title(
81::CODE;;"predict: %i\ntrue: %i"
82::CODE;;% (lp_model.transduction_[image_index], y[image_index]),
83::CODE;;size=10,
84::CODE;;)
85::CODE;;sub.axis("off")
87::CODE;;(delete_index,) = (unlabeled_indices == image_index).nonzero()
88::CODE;;delete_indices = np.concatenate((delete_indices, delete_index))
89::CODE;;unlabeled_indices = np.delete(unlabeled_indices, delete_indices)
90::CODE;;n_labeled_points += len(uncertainty_index)
91::CODE;;f.suptitle(
92::CODE;;(
93::CODE;;"Active learning with Label Propagation.\nRows show 5 most "
94::CODE;;"uncertain labels to learn with the next model."
95::CODE;;),

97::CODE;;)

44::CODE;;scores = np.empty((x_values.shape[0], n_splits))
45::CODE;;amount_labeled = np.empty((x_values.shape[0], n_splits))
46::CODE;;amount_iterations = np.empty((x_values.shape[0], n_splits))
47::CODE;;for i, threshold in enumerate(x_values):
48::CODE;;self_training_clf = SelfTrainingClassifier(base_classifier, threshold=threshold)
51::CODE;;skfolds = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=n_splits)
52::CODE;;for fold, (train_index, test_index) in enumerate(skfolds.split(X, y)):
53::CODE;;X_train = X[train_index]
54::CODE;;y_train = y[train_index]
55::CODE;;X_test = X[test_index]
56::CODE;;y_test = y[test_index]
57::CODE;;y_test_true = y_true[test_index]
58::CODE;;self_training_clf.fit(X_train, y_train)
60::CODE;;amount_labeled[i, fold] = (
61::CODE;;total_samples
62::CODE;;- np.unique(self_training_clf.labeled_iter_, return_counts=True)[1][0]
63::CODE;;)
65::CODE;;amount_iterations[i, fold] = np.max(self_training_clf.labeled_iter_)
66::CODE;;y_pred = self_training_clf.predict(X_test)
67::CODE;;scores[i, fold] = accuracy_score(y_test_true, y_pred)
68::CODE;;ax1 = plt.subplot(211)
69::CODE;;ax1.errorbar(
70::CODE;;x_values, scores.mean(axis=1), yerr=scores.std(axis=1), capsize=2, color="b"
71::CODE;;)
72::CODE;;ax1.set_ylabel("Accuracy", color="b")
73::CODE;;ax1.tick_params("y", colors="b")
74::CODE;;ax2 = ax1.twinx()
75::CODE;;ax2.errorbar(
76::CODE;;x_values,
77::CODE;;amount_labeled.mean(axis=1),
78::CODE;;yerr=amount_labeled.std(axis=1),
79::CODE;;capsize=2,
80::CODE;;color="g",
81::CODE;;)
82::CODE;;ax2.set_ylim(bottom=0)

38::CODE;;yy_down = yy - np.sqrt(1 + a**2) * margin
39::CODE;;yy_up = yy + np.sqrt(1 + a**2) * margin

42::CODE;;plt.clf()

44::CODE;;plt.plot(xx, yy_down, "k--")

47::CODE;;clf.support_vectors_[:, 0],
48::CODE;;clf.support_vectors_[:, 1],
49::CODE;;s=80,
50::CODE;;facecolors="none",
51::CODE;;zorder=10,
52::CODE;;edgecolors="k",
53::CODE;;)

33::CODE;;X_plot, y_plot = X[plot_indices], y[plot_indices]
34::CODE;;def plot_decision_function(classifier, sample_weight, axis, title):
37::CODE;;axis.scatter(
38::CODE;;X_plot[:, 0],
39::CODE;;X_plot[:, 1],
40::CODE;;c=y_plot,
41::CODE;;s=100 * sample_weight[plot_indices],

44::CODE;;edgecolors="black",
45::CODE;;)
46::CODE;;DecisionBoundaryDisplay.from_estimator(
47::CODE;;classifier,
48::CODE;;X_plot,
49::CODE;;response_method="decision_function",
50::CODE;;alpha=0.75,
51::CODE;;ax=axis,
52::CODE;;cmap=plt.cm.bone,
53::CODE;;)
54::CODE;;axis.axis("off")
55::CODE;;axis.set_title(title)
57::CODE;;sample_weight_constant = np.ones(len(X))
59::CODE;;sample_weight_modified = abs(rng.randn(len(X)))
61::CODE;;positive_class_indices = np.asarray(y == 1).nonzero()[0]
62::CODE;;sample_weight_modified[positive_class_indices] *= 15

65::CODE;;clf_no_weights.fit(X, y)
67::CODE;;clf_weights = SVC(gamma=1)

71::CODE;;clf_no_weights, sample_weight_constant, axes[0], "Constant weights"

108::CODE;;metrics.adjusted_rand_score(labels, km.labels_)

111::CODE;;metrics.silhouette_score(X, km.labels_, sample_size=2000)
112::CODE;;)

99::CODE;;)
100::CODE;;)
101::CODE;;else:
102::CODE;;print(

82::CODE;;computation time and memory on expensive operations that can be
83::CODE;;performed in chunks. Global default: 1024.

89::CODE;;behaviour would be to print 'SVC(C=1.0, cache_size=200, ...)' with
90::CODE;;all the non-changed parameters. Global default: True.

70::CODE;;Convention:
71::CODE;;- link function g: raw_prediction = g(y_pred)
72::CODE;;- inverse link h: y_pred = h(raw_prediction)
73::CODE;;For (generalized) linear models, `raw_prediction = X @ coef` is the so
74::CODE;;called linear predictor, and `y_pred = h(raw_prediction)` is the predicted
75::CODE;;conditional (on X) expected value of the target `y_true`.
76::CODE;;The methods are not implemented as staticmethods in case a link function needs
77::CODE;;parameters.
87::CODE;;The link function maps (predicted) target values to raw predictions,
88::CODE;;i.e. `g(y_pred) = raw_prediction`.

616::CODE;;return median + np.average(term, weights=sample_weight)

708::CODE;;)

712::CODE;;if sample_weight is not None:

714::CODE;;return term

1186::CODE;;def test_tweedie_log_identity_consistency(p):
40::CODE;;Clone does a deep copy of the model in an estimator
41::CODE;;without actually copying attached data. It returns a new estimator
42::CODE;;with the same parameters that has not been fitted on any data.
43::CODE;;.. versionchanged:: 1.3
44::CODE;;Delegates to `estimator.__sklearn_clone__` if the method exists.
45::CODE;;Parameters
46::CODE;;----------
47::CODE;;estimator : {list, tuple, set} of estimator instance or a single \
48::CODE;;estimator instance
49::CODE;;The estimator or group of estimators to be cloned.
50::CODE;;safe : bool, default=True
51::CODE;;If safe is False, clone will fall back to a deep copy on objects
52::CODE;;that are not estimators. Ignored if `estimator.__sklearn_clone__`
53::CODE;;exists.
54::CODE;;Returns
55::CODE;;-------
56::CODE;;estimator : object
57::CODE;;The deep copy of the input, an estimator if input is an estimator.
58::CODE;;Notes
59::CODE;;-----
60::CODE;;If the estimator's `random_state` parameter is an integer (or if the
61::CODE;;estimator doesn't have a `random_state` parameter), an *exact clone* is
62::CODE;;returned: the clone and the original estimator will give the exact same
63::CODE;;results. Otherwise, *statistical clone* is returned: the clone might
64::CODE;;return different results from the original estimator. More details can be
65::CODE;;found in :ref:`randomness`.
66::CODE;;Examples
67::CODE;;--------
68::CODE;;>>> from sklearn.base import clone
69::CODE;;>>> from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
70::CODE;;>>> X = [[-1, 0], [0, 1], [0, -1], [1, 0]]
71::CODE;;>>> y = [0, 0, 1, 1]
72::CODE;;>>> classifier = LogisticRegression().fit(X, y)
73::CODE;;>>> cloned_classifier = clone(classifier)
74::CODE;;>>> hasattr(classifier, "classes_")
75::CODE;;True
76::CODE;;>>> hasattr(cloned_classifier, "classes_")
77::CODE;;False
78::CODE;;>>> classifier is cloned_classifier
79::CODE;;False
86::CODE;;estimator_type = type(estimator)
87::CODE;;if estimator_type is dict:
88::CODE;;return {k: clone(v, safe=safe) for k, v in estimator.items()}
89::CODE;;elif estimator_type in (list, tuple, set, frozenset):
90::CODE;;return estimator_type([clone(e, safe=safe) for e in estimator])
91::CODE;;elif not hasattr(estimator, "get_params") or isinstance(estimator, type):
92::CODE;;if not safe:
93::CODE;;return copy.deepcopy(estimator)
94::CODE;;else:
95::CODE;;if isinstance(estimator, type):
96::CODE;;raise TypeError(
97::CODE;;"Cannot clone object. "
98::CODE;;"You should provide an instance of "
99::CODE;;"scikit-learn estimator instead of a class."
100::CODE;;)
101::CODE;;else:
102::CODE;;raise TypeError(
103::CODE;;"Cannot clone object '%s' (type %s): "
104::CODE;;"it does not seem to be a scikit-learn "
105::CODE;;"estimator as it does not implement a "
106::CODE;;"'get_params' method." % (repr(estimator), type(estimator))
107::CODE;;)
108::CODE;;klass = estimator.__class__
109::CODE;;new_object_params = estimator.get_params(deep=False)
110::CODE;;for name, param in new_object_params.items():
111::CODE;;new_object_params[name] = clone(param, safe=False)
112::CODE;;new_object = klass(**new_object_params)
113::CODE;;try:
114::CODE;;new_object._metadata_request = copy.deepcopy(estimator._metadata_request)
115::CODE;;except AttributeError:
116::CODE;;pass
117::CODE;;params_set = new_object.get_params(deep=False)
119::CODE;;for name in new_object_params:
120::CODE;;param1 = new_object_params[name]
121::CODE;;param2 = params_set[name]
122::CODE;;if param1 is not param2:
123::CODE;;raise RuntimeError(
124::CODE;;"Cannot clone object %s, as the constructor "
125::CODE;;"either does not set or modifies parameter %s" % (estimator, name)
126::CODE;;)
129::CODE;;if hasattr(estimator, "_sklearn_output_config"):
130::CODE;;new_object._sklearn_output_config = copy.deepcopy(
131::CODE;;estimator._sklearn_output_config
132::CODE;;)
133::CODE;;return new_object

68::CODE;;This class uses cross-validation to both estimate the parameters of a
69::CODE;;classifier and subsequently calibrate a classifier. With
70::CODE;;`ensemble=True`, for each cv split it
71::CODE;;fits a copy of the base estimator to the training subset, and calibrates it
72::CODE;;using the testing subset. For prediction, predicted probabilities are
73::CODE;;averaged across these individual calibrated classifiers. When
74::CODE;;`ensemble=False`, cross-validation is used to obtain unbiased predictions,
75::CODE;;via :func:`~sklearn.model_selection.cross_val_predict`, which are then
76::CODE;;used for calibration. For prediction, the base estimator, trained using all
77::CODE;;the data, is used. This is the prediction method implemented when
78::CODE;;`probabilities=True` for :class:`~sklearn.svm.SVC` and :class:`~sklearn.svm.NuSVC`
79::CODE;;estimators (see :ref:`User Guide <scores_probabilities>` for details).
80::CODE;;Already fitted classifiers can be calibrated by wrapping the model in a
81::CODE;;:class:`~sklearn.frozen.FrozenEstimator`. In this case all provided
82::CODE;;data is used for calibration. The user has to take care manually that data
83::CODE;;for model fitting and calibration are disjoint.
84::CODE;;The calibration is based on the :term:`decision_function` method of the
85::CODE;;`estimator` if it exists, else on :term:`predict_proba`.
86::CODE;;Read more in the :ref:`User Guide <calibration>`.
87::CODE;;In order to learn more on the CalibratedClassifierCV class, see the
88::CODE;;following calibration examples:
89::CODE;;:ref:`sphx_glr_auto_examples_calibration_plot_calibration.py`,
90::CODE;;:ref:`sphx_glr_auto_examples_calibration_plot_calibration_curve.py`, and
91::CODE;;:ref:`sphx_glr_auto_examples_calibration_plot_calibration_multiclass.py`.
92::CODE;;Parameters
93::CODE;;----------
94::CODE;;estimator : estimator instance, default=None
95::CODE;;The classifier whose output need to be calibrated to provide more
96::CODE;;accurate `predict_proba` outputs. The default classifier is
97::CODE;;a :class:`~sklearn.svm.LinearSVC`.
98::CODE;;.. versionadded:: 1.2
99::CODE;;method : {'sigmoid', 'isotonic', 'temperature'}, default='sigmoid'
100::CODE;;The method to use for calibration. Can be:
101::CODE;;- 'sigmoid', which corresponds to Platt's method (i.e. a binary logistic
102::CODE;;regression model).
103::CODE;;- 'isotonic', which is a non-parametric approach.
104::CODE;;- 'temperature', temperature scaling.
105::CODE;;Sigmoid and isotonic calibration methods natively support only binary
106::CODE;;classifiers and extend to multi-class classification using a One-vs-Rest (OvR)
107::CODE;;strategy with post-hoc renormalization, i.e., adjusting the probabilities after
108::CODE;;calibration to ensure they sum up to 1.
109::CODE;;In contrast, temperature scaling naturally supports multi-class calibration by
110::CODE;;applying `softmax(classifier_logits/T)` with a value of `T` (temperature)
111::CODE;;that optimizes the log loss.
112::CODE;;For very uncalibrated classifiers on very imbalanced datasets, sigmoid
113::CODE;;calibration might be preferred because it fits an additional intercept
114::CODE;;parameter. This helps shift decision boundaries appropriately when the
115::CODE;;classifier being calibrated is biased towards the majority class.
116::CODE;;Isotonic calibration is not recommended when the number of calibration samples
117::CODE;;is too low ``(≪1000)`` since it then tends to overfit.
118::CODE;;.. versionchanged:: 1.8
119::CODE;;Added option 'temperature'.
120::CODE;;cv : int, cross-validation generator, or iterable, default=None
121::CODE;;Determines the cross-validation splitting strategy.
122::CODE;;Possible inputs for cv are:
123::CODE;;- None, to use the default 5-fold cross-validation,
124::CODE;;- integer, to specify the number of folds.
125::CODE;;- :term:`CV splitter`,
126::CODE;;- An iterable yielding (train, test) splits as arrays of indices.
127::CODE;;For integer/None inputs, if ``y`` is binary or multiclass,
128::CODE;;:class:`~sklearn.model_selection.StratifiedKFold` is used. If ``y`` is
129::CODE;;neither binary nor multiclass, :class:`~sklearn.model_selection.KFold`
130::CODE;;is used.
131::CODE;;Refer to the :ref:`User Guide <cross_validation>` for the various
132::CODE;;cross-validation strategies that can be used here.
133::CODE;;.. versionchanged:: 0.22
134::CODE;;``cv`` default value if None changed from 3-fold to 5-fold.
135::CODE;;n_jobs : int, default=None
136::CODE;;Number of jobs to run in parallel.
137::CODE;;``None`` means 1 unless in a :obj:`joblib.parallel_backend` context.
138::CODE;;``-1`` means using all processors.
139::CODE;;Base estimator clones are fitted in parallel across cross-validation
140::CODE;;iterations.
141::CODE;;See :term:`Glossary <n_jobs>` for more details.
142::CODE;;.. versionadded:: 0.24
143::CODE;;ensemble : bool, or "auto", default="auto"
144::CODE;;Determines how the calibrator is fitted.
145::CODE;;"auto" will use `False` if the `estimator` is a
146::CODE;;:class:`~sklearn.frozen.FrozenEstimator`, and `True` otherwise.
147::CODE;;If `True`, the `estimator` is fitted using training data, and
148::CODE;;calibrated using testing data, for each `cv` fold. The final estimator
149::CODE;;is an ensemble of `n_cv` fitted classifier and calibrator pairs, where
150::CODE;;`n_cv` is the number of cross-validation folds. The output is the
151::CODE;;average predicted probabilities of all pairs.
152::CODE;;If `False`, `cv` is used to compute unbiased predictions, via
153::CODE;;:func:`~sklearn.model_selection.cross_val_predict`, which are then
154::CODE;;used for calibration. At prediction time, the classifier used is the
155::CODE;;`estimator` trained on all the data.
156::CODE;;Note that this method is also internally implemented in
157::CODE;;:mod:`sklearn.svm` estimators with the `probabilities=True` parameter.
158::CODE;;.. versionadded:: 0.24
159::CODE;;.. versionchanged:: 1.6
160::CODE;;`"auto"` option is added and is the default.
161::CODE;;Attributes
162::CODE;;----------
163::CODE;;classes_ : ndarray of shape (n_classes,)
164::CODE;;The class labels.
165::CODE;;n_features_in_ : int
166::CODE;;Number of features seen during :term:`fit`. Only defined if the
167::CODE;;underlying estimator exposes such an attribute when fit.
168::CODE;;.. versionadded:: 0.24
169::CODE;;feature_names_in_ : ndarray of shape (`n_features_in_`,)
170::CODE;;Names of features seen during :term:`fit`. Only defined if the
171::CODE;;underlying estimator exposes such an attribute when fit.
172::CODE;;.. versionadded:: 1.0
173::CODE;;calibrated_classifiers_ : list (len() equal to cv or 1 if `ensemble=False`)
174::CODE;;The list of classifier and calibrator pairs.
175::CODE;;- When `ensemble=True`, `n_cv` fitted `estimator` and calibrator pairs.
176::CODE;;`n_cv` is the number of cross-validation folds.
177::CODE;;- When `ensemble=False`, the `estimator`, fitted on all the data, and fitted
178::CODE;;calibrator.
179::CODE;;.. versionchanged:: 0.24
180::CODE;;Single calibrated classifier case when `ensemble=False`.
181::CODE;;See Also
182::CODE;;--------
183::CODE;;calibration_curve : Compute true and predicted probabilities
184::CODE;;for a calibration curve.
185::CODE;;References
186::CODE;;----------
187::CODE;;.. [1] B. Zadrozny & C. Elkan.
188::CODE;;`Obtaining calibrated probability estimates from decision trees

220::CODE;;3
221::CODE;;>>> calibrated_clf.predict_proba(X)[:5, :]
222::CODE;;array([[0.110, 0.889],
223::CODE;;[0.072, 0.927],
224::CODE;;[0.928, 0.072],
225::CODE;;[0.928, 0.072],
226::CODE;;[0.072, 0.928]])
227::CODE;;>>> from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
228::CODE;;>>> X, y = make_classification(n_samples=100, n_features=2,
229::CODE;;... n_redundant=0, random_state=42)
230::CODE;;>>> X_train, X_calib, y_train, y_calib = train_test_split(
231::CODE;;... X, y, random_state=42

238::CODE;;>>> calibrated_clf.fit(X_calib, y_calib)
239::CODE;;CalibratedClassifierCV(...)

241::CODE;;1

243::CODE;;array([[0.936, 0.063]])

584::CODE;;def _fit_calibrator(clf, predictions, y, classes, method, xp, sample_weight=None):
611::CODE;;calibrators = []
612::CODE;;if method in ("isotonic", "sigmoid"):
613::CODE;;Y = label_binarize(y, classes=classes)
614::CODE;;label_encoder = LabelEncoder().fit(classes)
615::CODE;;pos_class_indices = label_encoder.transform(clf.classes_)
616::CODE;;for class_idx, this_pred in zip(pos_class_indices, predictions.T):
617::CODE;;if method == "isotonic":
618::CODE;;calibrator = IsotonicRegression(out_of_bounds="clip")
620::CODE;;calibrator = _SigmoidCalibration()
621::CODE;;calibrator.fit(this_pred, Y[:, class_idx], sample_weight)
622::CODE;;calibrators.append(calibrator)
623::CODE;;elif method == "temperature":
624::CODE;;if classes.shape[0] == 2 and predictions.shape[-1] == 1:
625::CODE;;response_method_name = _check_response_method(
626::CODE;;clf,
627::CODE;;["decision_function", "predict_proba"],
628::CODE;;).__name__

633::CODE;;calibrators.append(calibrator)

636::CODE;;class _CalibratedClassifier:
654::CODE;;def __init__(self, estimator, calibrators, *, classes, method="sigmoid"):
655::CODE;;self.estimator = estimator
656::CODE;;self.calibrators = calibrators
657::CODE;;self.classes = classes

659::CODE;;def predict_proba(self, X):
672::CODE;;predictions, _ = _get_response_values(
673::CODE;;self.estimator,
674::CODE;;X,
675::CODE;;response_method=["decision_function", "predict_proba"],
676::CODE;;)
677::CODE;;if predictions.ndim == 1:
679::CODE;;predictions = predictions.reshape(-1, 1)
680::CODE;;n_classes = self.classes.shape[0]
681::CODE;;proba = np.zeros((_num_samples(X), n_classes))
682::CODE;;if self.method in ("sigmoid", "isotonic"):
683::CODE;;label_encoder = LabelEncoder().fit(self.classes)
684::CODE;;pos_class_indices = label_encoder.transform(self.estimator.classes_)
685::CODE;;for class_idx, this_pred, calibrator in zip(
686::CODE;;pos_class_indices, predictions.T, self.calibrators
687::CODE;;):
688::CODE;;if n_classes == 2:
691::CODE;;class_idx += 1
692::CODE;;proba[:, class_idx] = calibrator.predict(this_pred)
694::CODE;;if n_classes == 2:
695::CODE;;proba[:, 0] = 1.0 - proba[:, 1]
696::CODE;;else:
697::CODE;;denominator = np.sum(proba, axis=1)[:, np.newaxis]
701::CODE;;uniform_proba = np.full_like(proba, 1 / n_classes)
702::CODE;;proba = np.divide(
703::CODE;;proba, denominator, out=uniform_proba, where=denominator != 0
704::CODE;;)
705::CODE;;elif self.method == "temperature":
706::CODE;;xp, _ = get_namespace(predictions)
707::CODE;;if n_classes == 2 and predictions.shape[-1] == 1:
708::CODE;;response_method_name = _check_response_method(
709::CODE;;self.estimator,
710::CODE;;["decision_function", "predict_proba"],
711::CODE;;).__name__
712::CODE;;if response_method_name == "predict_proba":
713::CODE;;predictions = xp.concat([1 - predictions, predictions], axis=1)
714::CODE;;proba = self.calibrators[0].predict(predictions)
716::CODE;;proba[(1.0 < proba) & (proba <= 1.0 + 1e-5)] = 1.0
717::CODE;;return proba
720::CODE;;def _sigmoid_calibration(
721::CODE;;predictions, y, sample_weight=None, max_abs_prediction_threshold=30
722::CODE;;):
742::CODE;;predictions = column_or_1d(predictions)
743::CODE;;y = column_or_1d(y)
745::CODE;;scale_constant = 1.0
746::CODE;;max_prediction = np.max(np.abs(F))
752::CODE;;if max_prediction >= max_abs_prediction_threshold:
753::CODE;;scale_constant = max_prediction
756::CODE;;F = F / scale_constant
760::CODE;;mask_negative_samples = y <= 0
761::CODE;;if sample_weight is not None:
762::CODE;;prior0 = (sample_weight[mask_negative_samples]).sum()
763::CODE;;prior1 = (sample_weight[~mask_negative_samples]).sum()
764::CODE;;else:
765::CODE;;prior0 = float(np.sum(mask_negative_samples))
766::CODE;;prior1 = y.shape[0] - prior0
767::CODE;;T = np.zeros_like(y, dtype=predictions.dtype)
768::CODE;;T[y > 0] = (prior1 + 1.0) / (prior1 + 2.0)
769::CODE;;T[y <= 0] = 1.0 / (prior0 + 2.0)
770::CODE;;bin_loss = HalfBinomialLoss()
771::CODE;;def loss_grad(AB):
776::CODE;;raw_prediction = -(AB[0] * F + AB[1]).astype(dtype=predictions.dtype)
777::CODE;;l, g = bin_loss.loss_gradient(
778::CODE;;y_true=T,
779::CODE;;raw_prediction=raw_prediction,
780::CODE;;sample_weight=sample_weight,
781::CODE;;)
782::CODE;;loss = l.sum()
787::CODE;;grad = np.asarray([-g @ F, -g.sum()], dtype=np.float64)
788::CODE;;return loss, grad
789::CODE;;AB0 = np.array([0.0, log((prior0 + 1.0) / (prior1 + 1.0))])
790::CODE;;opt_result = minimize(
791::CODE;;loss_grad,
792::CODE;;AB0,
793::CODE;;method="L-BFGS-B",
794::CODE;;jac=True,
795::CODE;;options={
796::CODE;;"gtol": 1e-6,
797::CODE;;"ftol": 64 * np.finfo(float).eps,
798::CODE;;},
799::CODE;;)
800::CODE;;AB_ = opt_result.x
804::CODE;;return AB_[0] / scale_constant, AB_[1]
805::CODE;;def _convert_to_logits(decision_values, eps=1e-12, xp=None):
827::CODE;;xp, _, device_ = get_namespace_and_device(decision_values, xp=xp)
828::CODE;;decision_values = check_array(
829::CODE;;decision_values, dtype=[xp.float64, xp.float32], ensure_2d=False
830::CODE;;)
831::CODE;;if (decision_values.ndim == 2) and (decision_values.shape[1] > 1):
833::CODE;;entries_zero_to_one = xp.all((decision_values >= 0) & (decision_values <= 1))
836::CODE;;row_sums_to_one = xp.all(
837::CODE;;xpx.isclose(
838::CODE;;xp.sum(decision_values, axis=1),
839::CODE;;xp.asarray(1.0, device=device_, dtype=decision_values.dtype),
840::CODE;;)
841::CODE;;)
842::CODE;;if entries_zero_to_one and row_sums_to_one:
843::CODE;;logits = xp.log(decision_values + eps)
844::CODE;;else:
845::CODE;;logits = decision_values
846::CODE;;elif (decision_values.ndim == 2) and (decision_values.shape[1] == 1):
847::CODE;;logits = xp.concat([-decision_values, decision_values], axis=1)
848::CODE;;elif decision_values.ndim == 1:
849::CODE;;decision_values = xp.reshape(decision_values, (-1, 1))
850::CODE;;logits = xp.concat([-decision_values, decision_values], axis=1)
851::CODE;;return logits
852::CODE;;class _SigmoidCalibration(RegressorMixin, BaseEstimator):
861::CODE;;def fit(self, X, y, sample_weight=None):
876::CODE;;X = column_or_1d(X)
877::CODE;;y = column_or_1d(y)
878::CODE;;X, y = indexable(X, y)
879::CODE;;self.a_, self.b_ = _sigmoid_calibration(X, y, sample_weight)
880::CODE;;return self
881::CODE;;def predict(self, T):
892::CODE;;T = column_or_1d(T)
893::CODE;;return expit(-(self.a_ * T + self.b_))
894::CODE;;class _TemperatureScaling(RegressorMixin, BaseEstimator):
901::CODE;;def fit(self, X, y, sample_weight=None):
923::CODE;;xp, _, xp_device = get_namespace_and_device(X, y)
924::CODE;;X, y = indexable(X, y)
925::CODE;;check_consistent_length(X, y)
927::CODE;;dtype_ = logits.dtype
928::CODE;;labels = column_or_1d(y, dtype=dtype_)
929::CODE;;if sample_weight is not None:
930::CODE;;sample_weight = _check_sample_weight(sample_weight, labels, dtype=dtype_)
931::CODE;;if _is_numpy_namespace(xp):
932::CODE;;multinomial_loss = HalfMultinomialLoss(n_classes=logits.shape[1])
933::CODE;;else:
934::CODE;;multinomial_loss = partial(_half_multinomial_loss, xp=xp)
935::CODE;;def log_loss(log_beta=0.0):
960::CODE;;log_beta = xp.asarray(log_beta, dtype=dtype_, device=xp_device)
961::CODE;;raw_prediction = xp.exp(log_beta) * logits
962::CODE;;return multinomial_loss(labels, raw_prediction, sample_weight)
963::CODE;;xatol = 64 * xp.finfo(dtype_).eps
964::CODE;;log_beta_minimizer = minimize_scalar(
965::CODE;;log_loss,
966::CODE;;bounds=(-10.0, 10.0),
967::CODE;;options={
968::CODE;;"xatol": xatol,
969::CODE;;},
970::CODE;;)
972::CODE;;raise RuntimeError(
973::CODE;;"Temperature scaling fails to optimize during calibration. "
974::CODE;;"Reason from `scipy.optimize.minimize_scalar`: "
975::CODE;;f"{log_beta_minimizer.message}"
976::CODE;;)
977::CODE;;self.beta_ = xp.exp(
978::CODE;;xp.asarray(log_beta_minimizer.x, dtype=dtype_, device=xp_device)
979::CODE;;)
980::CODE;;return self
981::CODE;;def predict(self, X):
999::CODE;;logits = _convert_to_logits(X)
1000::CODE;;return softmax(self.beta_ * logits)

1006::CODE;;@validate_params(
1007::CODE;;{
1008::CODE;;"y_true": ["array-like"],
1009::CODE;;"y_prob": ["array-like"],
1010::CODE;;"pos_label": [Real, str, "boolean", None],
1011::CODE;;"n_bins": [Interval(Integral, 1, None, closed="left")],
1012::CODE;;"strategy": [StrOptions({"uniform", "quantile"})],
1013::CODE;;},
1014::CODE;;prefer_skip_nested_validation=True,
1015::CODE;;)
1016::CODE;;def calibration_curve(
1017::CODE;;y_true,
1018::CODE;;y_prob,
1019::CODE;;*,
1020::CODE;;pos_label=None,
1021::CODE;;n_bins=5,
1022::CODE;;strategy="uniform",
1023::CODE;;):
1080::CODE;;y_true = column_or_1d(y_true)
1081::CODE;;y_prob = column_or_1d(y_prob)
1082::CODE;;check_consistent_length(y_true, y_prob)
1083::CODE;;pos_label = _check_pos_label_consistency(pos_label, y_true)
1084::CODE;;if y_prob.min() < 0 or y_prob.max() > 1:
1085::CODE;;raise ValueError("y_prob has values outside [0, 1].")
1086::CODE;;labels = np.unique(y_true)
1087::CODE;;if len(labels) > 2:
1088::CODE;;raise ValueError(
1089::CODE;;f"Only binary classification is supported. Provided labels {labels}."
1090::CODE;;)
1091::CODE;;y_true = y_true == pos_label
1093::CODE;;quantiles = np.linspace(0, 1, n_bins + 1)
1094::CODE;;bins = np.percentile(y_prob, quantiles * 100)
1095::CODE;;elif strategy == "uniform":
1096::CODE;;bins = np.linspace(0.0, 1.0, n_bins + 1)
1097::CODE;;else:
1098::CODE;;raise ValueError(
1099::CODE;;"Invalid entry to 'strategy' input. Strategy "
1100::CODE;;"must be either 'quantile' or 'uniform'."
1101::CODE;;)
1102::CODE;;binids = np.searchsorted(bins[1:-1], y_prob)
1103::CODE;;bin_sums = np.bincount(binids, weights=y_prob, minlength=len(bins))
1104::CODE;;bin_true = np.bincount(binids, weights=y_true, minlength=len(bins))
1105::CODE;;bin_total = np.bincount(binids, minlength=len(bins))
1106::CODE;;nonzero = bin_total != 0
1107::CODE;;prob_true = bin_true[nonzero] / bin_total[nonzero]
1108::CODE;;prob_pred = bin_sums[nonzero] / bin_total[nonzero]
1109::CODE;;return prob_true, prob_pred

53::CODE;;else (np.array([0]), np.array([0] * n_samples))

56::CODE;;S.flat[:: (n_samples + 1)] = preference
57::CODE;;A = np.zeros((n_samples, n_samples))
60::CODE;;tmp = np.zeros((n_samples, n_samples))
62::CODE;;S += (
63::CODE;;np.finfo(S.dtype).eps * S + np.finfo(S.dtype).tiny * 100
64::CODE;;) * random_state.standard_normal(size=(n_samples, n_samples))
66::CODE;;e = np.zeros((n_samples, convergence_iter))
67::CODE;;ind = np.arange(n_samples)
68::CODE;;for it in range(max_iter):
70::CODE;;np.add(A, S, tmp)
71::CODE;;I = np.argmax(tmp, axis=1)
73::CODE;;tmp[ind, I] = -np.inf
74::CODE;;Y2 = np.max(tmp, axis=1)
76::CODE;;np.subtract(S, Y[:, None], tmp)
77::CODE;;tmp[ind, I] = S[ind, I] - Y2
79::CODE;;tmp *= 1 - damping
80::CODE;;R *= damping
81::CODE;;R += tmp
83::CODE;;np.maximum(R, 0, out=tmp)
84::CODE;;tmp.flat[:: n_samples + 1] = R.flat[:: n_samples + 1]
86::CODE;;tmp -= np.sum(tmp, axis=0)
87::CODE;;dA = np.diag(tmp).copy()
88::CODE;;tmp.clip(0, np.inf, tmp)
89::CODE;;tmp.flat[:: n_samples + 1] = dA
91::CODE;;tmp *= 1 - damping
92::CODE;;A *= damping
93::CODE;;A -= tmp
95::CODE;;E = (np.diag(A) + np.diag(R)) > 0
96::CODE;;e[:, it % convergence_iter] = E
97::CODE;;K = np.sum(E, axis=0)
98::CODE;;if it >= convergence_iter:
99::CODE;;se = np.sum(e, axis=1)
100::CODE;;unconverged = np.sum((se == convergence_iter) + (se == 0)) != n_samples
101::CODE;;if (not unconverged and (K > 0)) or (it == max_iter):
102::CODE;;never_converged = False
103::CODE;;if verbose:
104::CODE;;print("Converged after %d iterations." % it)
105::CODE;;break
106::CODE;;else:
107::CODE;;never_converged = True
108::CODE;;if verbose:
109::CODE;;print("Did not converge")
110::CODE;;I = np.flatnonzero(E)
112::CODE;;if K > 0:
113::CODE;;if never_converged:
114::CODE;;warnings.warn(
115::CODE;;(
116::CODE;;"Affinity propagation did not converge, this model "
117::CODE;;"may return degenerate cluster centers and labels."
118::CODE;;),
119::CODE;;ConvergenceWarning,
120::CODE;;)
121::CODE;;c = np.argmax(S[:, I], axis=1)
124::CODE;;for k in range(K):
125::CODE;;ii = np.asarray(c == k).nonzero()[0]
126::CODE;;j = np.argmax(np.sum(S[ii[:, np.newaxis], ii], axis=0))
127::CODE;;I[k] = ii[j]
128::CODE;;c = np.argmax(S[:, I], axis=1)
129::CODE;;c[I] = np.arange(K)
130::CODE;;labels = I[c]
132::CODE;;cluster_centers_indices = np.unique(labels)
133::CODE;;labels = np.searchsorted(cluster_centers_indices, labels)
134::CODE;;else:

138::CODE;;"will not have any cluster centers."
139::CODE;;),
140::CODE;;ConvergenceWarning,

143::CODE;;cluster_centers_indices = []

145::CODE;;return cluster_centers_indices, labels, it + 1
146::CODE;;else:

559::CODE;;j = edge.b

564::CODE;;children.append((i, j))

567::CODE;;n_j = used_node[j]
568::CODE;;used_node[k] = n_i + n_j
569::CODE;;used_node[i] = used_node[j] = False
572::CODE;;coord_col = join_func(A[i], A[j], used_node, n_i, n_j)
573::CODE;;for col, d in coord_col:
574::CODE;;A[col].append(k, d)
577::CODE;;heappush(inertia, _hierarchical.WeightedEdge(d, k, col))
578::CODE;;A[k] = coord_col
580::CODE;;A[i] = A[j] = 0
582::CODE;;n_leaves = n_samples

585::CODE;;if return_distance:
586::CODE;;return children, n_connected_components, n_leaves, parent, distances
587::CODE;;return children, n_connected_components, n_leaves, parent

626::CODE;;if n_clusters > n_leaves:
627::CODE;;raise ValueError(
628::CODE;;"Cannot extract more clusters than samples: "
629::CODE;;f"{n_clusters} clusters were given for a tree with {n_leaves} leaves."
630::CODE;;)
636::CODE;;nodes = [-(max(children[-1]) + 1)]
637::CODE;;for _ in range(n_clusters - 1):

641::CODE;;heappush(nodes, -these_children[0])
642::CODE;;heappushpop(nodes, -these_children[1])
