411::CODE;;def _check_deprecated_start_requests_use(self):
412::CODE;;start_requests_cls = None
413::CODE;;start_cls = None
414::CODE;;spidercls = self._spider.__class__
415::CODE;;mro = spidercls.__mro__

418::CODE;;if start_requests_cls is None and "start_requests" in cls_dict:
419::CODE;;start_requests_cls = cls

421::CODE;;start_cls = cls

423::CODE;;break

43::CODE;;In Scrapy, an object is considered an ``item`` if it's supported by the
44::CODE;;`itemadapter`_ library. For example, when the output of a spider callback
45::CODE;;is evaluated, only such objects are passed to :ref:`item pipelines
46::CODE;;<topics-item-pipeline>`. :class:`Item` is one of the classes supported by

49::CODE;;in the ``fields`` attribute. This restricts the set of allowed field names
50::CODE;;and prevents typos, raising ``KeyError`` when referring to undefined fields.
51::CODE;;Additionally, fields can be used to define metadata and control the way
52::CODE;;data is processed internally. Please refer to the :ref:`documentation
53::CODE;;about fields <topics-items-fields>` for additional information.
54::CODE;;Unlike instances of :class:`dict`, instances of :class:`Item` may be

29::CODE;;class QueueProtocol(Protocol):
37::CODE;;FIFO queues). It uses one internal queue for each priority value. The internal
38::CODE;;queue must implement the following methods:
39::CODE;;* push(obj)
40::CODE;;* pop()
41::CODE;;* close()
42::CODE;;* __len__()
43::CODE;;Optionally, the queue could provide a ``peek`` method, that should return the
44::CODE;;next object to be returned by ``pop``, but without removing it from the queue.
45::CODE;;``__init__`` method of ScrapyPriorityQueue receives a downstream_queue_cls
46::CODE;;argument, which is a class used to instantiate a new (internal) queue when
47::CODE;;a new priority is allocated.
48::CODE;;Only integer priorities should be used. Lower numbers are higher
49::CODE;;priorities.
50::CODE;;startprios is a sequence of priorities to start with. If the queue was
51::CODE;;previously closed leaving some priority buckets non-empty, those priorities
52::CODE;;should be passed in startprios.
168::CODE;;but without removing it from the queue.
169::CODE;;Raises :exc:`NotImplementedError` if the underlying queue class does
170::CODE;;not implement a ``peek`` method, which is optional for queues.

89::CODE;;This function does a reverse search in a text using a regular expression
90::CODE;;given in the attribute 'pattern'.
91::CODE;;Since the re module does not provide this functionality, we have to find for
92::CODE;;the expression into chunks of text extracted from the end (for the sake of efficiency).
93::CODE;;At first, a chunk of 'chunk_size' kilobytes is extracted from the end, and searched for
94::CODE;;the pattern. If the pattern is not found, another chunk is extracted, and another
95::CODE;;search is performed.
96::CODE;;This process continues until a match is found, or until the whole file is read.
97::CODE;;In case the pattern wasn't found, None is returned, otherwise it returns a tuple containing
98::CODE;;the start position of the match, and the ending (regarding the entire text).

71::CODE;;return oct(path.stat().st_mode)

73::CODE;;renamings = renamings or ()

75::CODE;;".": get_permissions(path_obj),

79::CODE;;if ignore:
80::CODE;;ignored_names = ignore(root, nodes)
81::CODE;;nodes = [node for node in nodes if node not in ignored_names]
82::CODE;;for node in nodes:
83::CODE;;absolute_path = Path(root, node)
84::CODE;;relative_path = str(absolute_path.relative_to(path))
85::CODE;;for search_string, replacement in renamings:
86::CODE;;relative_path = relative_path.replace(search_string, replacement)
87::CODE;;permissions = get_permissions(absolute_path)
88::CODE;;permissions_dict[relative_path] = permissions
89::CODE;;return permissions_dict

861::CODE;;assert self.mw.process_response(request, response) is response
862::CODE;;SCHEME_PARAMS = ("url", "location", "target")
863::CODE;;HTTP_SCHEMES = ("http", "https")
864::CODE;;NON_HTTP_SCHEMES = ("data", "file", "ftp", "s3", "foo")
865::CODE;;REDIRECT_SCHEME_CASES = (
867::CODE;;*(
868::CODE;;(
869::CODE;;f"{input_scheme}://example.com/a",
870::CODE;;f"{output_scheme}://example.com/b",
871::CODE;;f"{output_scheme}://example.com/b",
872::CODE;;)
873::CODE;;for input_scheme, output_scheme in product(HTTP_SCHEMES, repeat=2)
874::CODE;;),
876::CODE;;*(
877::CODE;;(
878::CODE;;f"{input_scheme}://example.com/a",
879::CODE;;f"{output_scheme}://example.com/b",
880::CODE;;None,
881::CODE;;)
882::CODE;;for input_scheme in HTTP_SCHEMES
883::CODE;;for output_scheme in NON_HTTP_SCHEMES
884::CODE;;),
886::CODE;;*(
887::CODE;;(
888::CODE;;f"{scheme}://example.com/a",
889::CODE;;location,
890::CODE;;f"{scheme}://example.com/b",
891::CODE;;)
892::CODE;;for scheme in HTTP_SCHEMES
893::CODE;;for location in ("//example.com/b", "/b")
894::CODE;;),
897::CODE;;)
898::CODE;;@pytest.mark.parametrize(SCHEME_PARAMS, REDIRECT_SCHEME_CASES)
899::CODE;;def test_redirect_schemes(url, location, target):
900::CODE;;crawler = get_crawler(Spider)
901::CODE;;mw = RedirectMiddleware.from_crawler(crawler)
902::CODE;;request = Request(url)
903::CODE;;response = Response(url, headers={"Location": location}, status=301)
904::CODE;;redirect = mw.process_response(request, response)
905::CODE;;if target is None:
906::CODE;;assert redirect == response

686::CODE;;class IsExportingListener:

692::CODE;;self.start_without_finish = False
693::CODE;;self.finish_without_start = False

695::CODE;;if method == "start":
696::CODE;;self.start_without_finish = True

699::CODE;;self.start_without_finish = False
700::CODE;;else:
701::CODE;;self.finish_before_start = True
